Russia here. F ARM holds, F SEV stays out of ARM, and I won't attack Ankara or Armenia this spring. If you keep ARM and BLA clear of my units, we can both turn on Austria. What are your A ANK and F AEG orders?

Russia here. Your fleet on STP is the one thing blocking real cooperation. Austria is nearing a solo win with 9 centers. Move STP to BAR or NWY and I'll hold SWE and LVN away from you and join pressure on France or Germany.

Will F ION support F AEG–GRE this spring? Greece is empty; your support would overcome A BUL moving there. Taking Greece weakens Austria and gives us a foothold against Bulgaria. Keep A MUN and A SIL cooperating against Austria’s northern armies; we cannot afford further fighting between ourselves.

Taking Sevastopol broke my promise; I understand your anger. Austria now has nine centers and threatens us both. I propose F SEV–BLA this spring, leaving Sevastopol open for your recovery, with no attack on Rumania. Will you keep F RUM facing Austria rather than contesting BLA?

You offered a spring pause protecting Ankara and Smyrna. I will accept that pause if A CON stays out of both and A BUL does not move toward my homes. Are you maintaining that offer? I intend to move F SEV out, giving Russia an opportunity to recover its center.

Bohemia will support A TYR–MUN, not enter Silesia or threaten Berlin. I understand you refuse Kiel’s support, but ask that you at least refrain from supporting Italy in Munich. Removing Italy’s army gives us room to negotiate Munich’s future; preserving both Italian armies leaves your frontier exposed.

Agreed: no attacks between us. France’s fleets in ENG and IRI threaten your home centers directly. Keep F LON covering London while F NTH threatens Belgium or Holland, forcing French armies away from your coast. I will pressure Italy through Munich and the peninsula; I ask no English commitment against me in the Mediterranean.

Yes, I maintain the spring pause: A CON will hold, neither Ankara nor Smyrna will be attacked, and A BUL will not advance toward your homeland. Please order F AEG–ION; I will neither enter AEG nor support Italy there. Where will F SEV move? Advance notice would help avoid an accidental clash.

England here. Agreed Austria is the runaway. STP stays mine for now, but I won't attack Moscow, Warsaw, Livonia or Sweden. Hold SWE and LVN back and stay out of Norway. If you pressure Germany or Austria, I'll look at moving STP toward BAR later.

England here. Belgium is yours and I'm not contesting it. I'll keep NTH, EDI, YOR and LON away from Belgium, Picardy and Brest. I can't pull LON out while you have a fleet in the Channel. Pull it back and we can talk NTH. Holland is yours to pursue.

Agreed for this spring: Ruhr and Burgundy will not attack Holland, Kiel or Munich, provided Holland and Kiel stay out of Belgium and Ruhr. Burgundy will support Munich hold against Austria. Please add KIE support MUN hold; keeping Austria out matters more than changing Munich’s ownership. Can Berlin pressure Bohemia through Silesia with Italian agreement?

I already occupy the Channel; remaining there is not a new intrusion. I will not attack London this spring if you keep your stated peace around Belgium and Brest. Please confirm LON–NTH and NTH–NWG, or propose another concrete northern deployment. Will Edinburgh and Yorkshire remain home rather than convoy toward the continent?

Confirmed: PIE/GOL/WES remain demilitarized through 1904, and BUR will support MUN hold this spring. I am asking Germany for KIE support MUN hold too. Prefer SIL–BOH to cut Austria’s support if Germany confirms cooperation; otherwise SIL supporting Munich is prudent. Keep ION focused on defending Rome and resisting Naples/Trieste.

Germany here. Agreed, the North Sea stays quiet: keep F NTH and Helgoland off HOL, DEN and KIE. Austria at 9 is the threat. I'm not helping Austria take Munich. Kiel and Berlin hold, and I'd welcome your fleet pressure on France.

Germany here. I can't order Kiel to support TYR-MUN. Kiel and Berlin hold this spring, and I won't enter Silesia or Bohemia. Please keep BOH and TYR off my border. Take Italy on other fronts, such as Venice and Rome, instead.

Germany here. Agreed: A Kiel stays out of Munich and A Berlin stays out of Silesia this spring. Keep Silesia off Berlin. I will not support Austria's attack on Munich, so hold firm against Tyrolia and Bohemia.

Germany here. Agreed: my Kiel and Holland stay off Ruhr and Belgium. I won't support Austria against Munich, but I'm not committing Kiel to a Munich hold either. Keep Ruhr and Burgundy off Kiel, Holland and Munich. Austria is the shared problem.

Agreed: SIL stays out of BER, and MUN holds against Austria with SIL supporting. Please keep KIE out of MUN and BER out of SIL. Austria's BOH and TYR armies threaten both our positions; fighting over Munich now would hand Austria another center.

SIL will support MUN hold this spring, not enter BOH, GAL or PRU. Thank you for keeping WAR out of SIL and GAL. Can WAR move to GAL in autumn by agreement, threatening Vienna and Budapest? Pressure from RUM against BUL would also help divide Austria's armies.

Agreed to renew the PIE/GOL/WES DMZ through 1904. Please order BUR support MUN hold. I prefer SIL supporting MUN too: securing my last army-held center matters more than a speculative advance into BOH. ION will remain directed against Austria, coordinating with Turkey over Greece.

Agreed: F ION will support F AEG–GRE. Please order AEG–GRE and consider ANK–CON to pin Austria's eastern army. Note that NAP–ION would cut my support, although an unsupported attack cannot dislodge ION. Once you reach Greece, we can coordinate against BUL and Austria's fleets.

Russia here. Galicia stays empty this spring: A WAR holds and nothing of mine enters GAL. F RUM holds in Rumania. I'm watching Italian A SIL near Warsaw, so I'd welcome your pressure on Munich. Please keep BOH and VIE clear of GAL.

Russia here. I can't commit to a Black Sea deal yet. F RUM stays in Rumania and won't attack you this spring. Sevastopol is not yours to give. Clear your units from ARM and prove it with moves, then we can talk about Austria.

Your message refers to units no longer on the board: my fleet occupies SEV, and ARM is empty. I propose SEV–BLA, ANK–CON, and AEG–GRE against Austria. Please order RUM–BUL to cut Bulgarian support for Constantinople. I will not attack Rumania this spring.

I accept your spring guarantee against attacks on Ankara and Smyrna. F SEV will move toward BLA, not Armenia. I cannot commit to AEG–ION while your fleets threaten to replace Italy throughout the Mediterranean. Will you instead allow AEG–GRE, keeping A BUL out of Greece? That would make our pause materially worthwhile.

Agreed: I will order F AEG support F ION hold, rather than insist on Greece. Please hold ION and keep it out of AEG. A ANK–CON will pin Austria’s eastern army; F SEV–BLA prepares stronger pressure there in autumn. Can A MUN and A SIL coordinate an attack on BOH?

notes.note: Spring 1904: all hold. Austria has 9 centers and is the runaway. Told Austria and Italy that GAL stays empty. England holds STP but promised not to attack me. Turkey holds SEV, which is my lost center. Consider moves on STP or Austria later.

S1904: all hold. Promised Italy no KIE-MUN or BER-SIL, France no Ruhr/Belgium, England quiet North Sea. Austria at 9 is the threat; I refused to support TYR-MUN. Watch SIL, BOH, RUH and BUR against BER/KIE/HOL.

Spring 1904: all hold. No unowned centers reachable. Austria at 9 is the runaway. France has fleets in ENG and IRI near London. Promised not to enter BEL, PIC, BRE, HOL, DEN, KIE. Russia wants STP back.

ION supports Turkey AEG-GRE per latest offer; Turkish messages conflicted. MUN holds with promised French BUR support; SIL-BOH cuts Austrian support, departing promised SIL support. German KIE/BER truce; French western DMZ through 1904.

BEL-HOL with RUH support breaks German spring pact for growth. BUR supports Italian Munich as promised; western DMZ intact. ENG convoys PIC-WAL, IRI-LVP to seize English centers in fall; kept promise not to attack London this spring.

AEG–GRE follows Italy's latest promise of ION support; earlier crossed agreement was to support ION hold. ANK–CON pins Austria; SEV–BLA prepares autumn attack. Austria promised CON hold and no attacks on ANK/SMY. Russia promised RUM would not attack us.

TYR attacks MUN with BOH support; Germany refused help. VEN takes ROM; NAP-TYS targets TUN. TRI-ADR, VIE-TRI, BUD-SER reinforce west. BUL-GRE blocks Turkish demand; CON holds against attack. Honor spring Turkish home pause and Russian GAL/RUM peace.

messages.body: Will F RUM–BLA cut Turkish support for ANK–CON this fall? That would let me contest Greece without losing Constantinople and put your fleet in position to recover Sevastopol. I will keep Galicia empty and leave Rumania untouched. Please confirm whether you can make that attack.

France now occupies Holland and threatens Kiel. Please order A KIE support A TYR–MUN, with A BER–SIL cutting Italy’s attack on Bohemia. If I gain Munich, I offer its support to defend Kiel next spring. I will not attack Berlin or enter Silesia this fall.

Your fleet in Greece can attack ION with support from my F ADR, while F TYS takes Tunis. I propose exactly that combination this fall. In exchange, keep A ANK and F BLA from attacking Constantinople; I will leave Ankara and Smyrna untouched. Can you agree?

England here. I hold LVP and want no war with you. Austria has 9 centers and is the runaway. Let's both hold our home lines this fall, with no moves on London, Liverpool or the Channel coast. Then we can plan against Germany or Austria.

England here. Austria is the runaway. I'm holding STP and won't attack Sweden, Livonia, Moscow or Warsaw. Keep SWE and LVN quiet toward me, and we can talk about pressure on Germany and about Barents later.

England here. F NTH stays off HOL, DEN and KIE this fall. France has just taken Holland from you, so hold your lines against Austria and France. Tell me if you plan to move on Holland, and I'll keep the North Sea quiet.

I will order BUR support MUN hold this fall; please hold Munich and use SIL–BOH to cut Austrian support. Our western DMZ remains intact. Can ION cut ADR or TYS support while Turkey holds Greece? Preventing Austria consolidating Italy is essential; I can build southern forces this winter.

Please retain Greece and coordinate ION support GRE hold with Italy if needed. Austria can use SER to support BUL–GRE. Can BLA attack BUL’s east coast to cut support for CON, while ANK attacks CON? Pressure on Austria’s eastern armies will help Italy survive and keep Austria below runaway strength.

I intend to defend Italian Munich again with Burgundy. Will Kiel support MUN hold rather than help Austria break through? I recognize taking Holland broke our agreement. I propose no French attack on Kiel, Berlin or Denmark this fall; keeping Austria out of Munich gives us room to negotiate a durable settlement.

Germany here. Your A Holland is shown as mine, and HOL flips to you only if units stay put. I'm holding Holland, Kiel and Berlin. Ruhr must not enter Holland or Kiel. Austria at 9 is the real threat, so let's hold the line and not trade blows.

Germany here. The North Sea stays quiet: keep F NTH and your Yorkshire army off Holland, Kiel and Denmark. Austria is near 9 centers and is the real danger. Liverpool is yours, so use your fleets against France's Channel and Brittany side, not me.
Germany here. Kiel stays out of Munich and Berlin stays out of Silesia again this fall. Keep A Silesia off Berlin and hold Munich firmly against Tyrolia and Bohemia. Austria is the common enemy.

Please renew BUR support MUN hold this fall. SIL–BOH will cut Austrian support for TYR–MUN again. Austria occupies Rome and threatens my last fleet; keeping Munich secure is essential to my survival and to blocking Austrian expansion into Germany. Our PIE/GOL/WES DMZ remains intact.

Please order GRE support ION–NAP this fall. Recovering Naples offsets Rome’s loss and gets my fleet away from a possible ADR/TYS attack on ION. Can BLA support ANK–CON as well? I am asking Russia for RUM–BUL to cut Austrian support and interfere with BUL–GRE.

Will you order F RUM–BUL and A WAR–GAL this fall? BUL–GRE threatens Turkey’s gain; attacking BUL cuts its support for Constantinople and pressures Austria. WAR–GAL threatens Vienna and Budapest. SIL–BOH will cut support for Austria’s Munich attack; please keep WAR out of SIL.

Russia here. Austria at 9 centers is the threat. I'll consider A WAR-GAL this Fall only if you hit Austria hard: A SIL must not enter WAR or PRU, and you must press Tyrolia, Trieste or Venice. Tell me your exact Fall orders first.
Russia here. Austria's 9 centers threaten us both. I need SEV back. Move F SEV to BLA or ARM and I'll keep F RUM facing Bulgaria, not you. Hold ANK and don't enter RUM. Tell me your Fall orders.

Russia here. Austria is at 9 centers and leads the board. Please keep F STP/NORTH from moving on SWE or LVN this Fall. I'm keeping A WAR and A LVN home. If you shift against Germany or Austria, I'll back you.

Thank you for getting me into Greece. Please order F ION support F GRE hold this fall; Austria can attack from BUL with SER support. I plan A ANK–CON supported by F BLA. Can A SIL attack BOH again while A MUN holds? We must keep Austria fighting on both fronts.

My fleet has left Sevastopol and Armenia is empty. This fall I propose A ANK–CON supported by F BLA. Will you order F RUM–BUL to cut Bulgaria’s possible support for Constantinople? I will not attack Rumania or Sevastopol this fall. Together we can strip Austria of Constantinople while Italy helps defend Greece.

England here. Agreed, Austria is the runaway. F STP/NORTH holds and nothing of mine moves on Sweden, Livonia, Moscow or Warsaw this Fall. Keep SWE, LVN and WAR home and out of Norway. If you pressure Austria or Germany, I'll look at Barents afterward.

England here. F NTH and A YOR stay off HOL, KIE and DEN this Fall. Liverpool is under French threat, so I'll hold it and use my fleets against the Channel side. Hold Kiel and Berlin against Austria. If you retake Holland, tell me.

My fleet already occupies Liverpool; I propose it holds this fall, with Wales and Channel making no attack on London. If EDI and YOR leave Liverpool alone, I will make no further attack on your home centers this turn. We can then negotiate a northern settlement while I build against Austria.

Holland will hold; Ruhr will not attack Kiel this fall. Please order KIE support MUN hold: Burgundy will do the same, and Italy plans SIL–BOH to cut Austrian support. Your actual units are Berlin, Kiel and Denmark; there is no German army remaining in Holland. Let us stabilize this frontier.

Confirmed: BUR supports MUN hold this fall, and our PIE/GOL/WES DMZ remains intact. Please order MUN hold and SIL–BOH as proposed. I am again asking Germany for KIE support MUN hold. Keep ION directed against Austria; my expected winter builds can begin reinforcing the Mediterranean.

Germany here. Thanks. North Sea stays quiet on my side too. France took Holland and is the immediate danger to Kiel. If your F NTH and A YOR keep off HOL, KIE and DEN, I'll hold and not move toward you. Press Belgium or the Channel against France; Austria is the long-term problem.

Germany here. I can't order Kiel to support Tyrolia into Munich or send Berlin to Silesia. Both Kiel and Berlin hold this fall, and I won't attack you. Please keep Bohemia and Tyrolia off my border. Pursue Italy through Rome and Venice instead, not Germany.

Germany here. Kiel holds this fall and won't support Austria into Munich. I also won't commit Kiel to a Munich hold. Agreed on no French move against Kiel, Berlin or Denmark. Keep Ruhr and Burgundy off Kiel, and let's talk about Holland's future afterward.

My armies will order MUN hold and SIL–BOH, cutting Austrian support against Munich. Please order WAR–GAL and RUM–BUL: the latter cuts Bulgaria’s support for Constantinople, helping Turkey’s supported ANK–CON attack. Neither Italian army will enter WAR or PRU. Your pressure is essential while Austria occupies Rome.

Agreed: SIL stays out of BER, and MUN holds with French BUR support. SIL–BOH will cut Austrian support for TYR–MUN. Please keep KIE out of MUN and BER out of SIL as promised. If you can add KIE support MUN hold, that provides insurance against Austria cutting Burgundy’s support.

I agree to ION support GRE hold if you reciprocate with GRE support ION hold. Mutual support holds Greece against BUL/SER and Ionian against ADR/TYS, absent further intervention. Please confirm; my earlier request for GRE support ION–NAP was geographically impossible. MUN holds, SIL–BOH. Proceed with ANK–CON supported by BLA.

Confirmed: MUN holds and SIL–BOH cuts support; thank you for BUR support. I propose reciprocal defensive support between ION and Turkish GRE, protecting both against Austria’s two-unit attacks. Attacking ADR or TYS instead risks losing my last fleet without recovering a center. Please prioritize southern fleet builds; our western DMZ remains intact.

Russia here. A WAR and A LVN stay home and F SWE won't touch Norway. I'd still like F STP/NORTH moved to BAR or NWY soon. If you turn on Germany or Austria, I'll back you. Austria at 9 is the real threat.

Russia here. I can't send F RUM to BUL or A WAR to GAL this Fall. I'm watching my own centers. A WAR stays out of SIL. Hit Austria hard at Tyrolia, Trieste or Venice and we can talk about Galicia in spring.

Russia here. Good that SEV is empty; I'll take it back. I won't attack ANK or ARM, and F RUM won't enter BUL this fall. Keep ANK out of RUM and SEV. If Austria stalls on CON, we can talk about Bulgaria next spring.

Russia here. I can't send F RUM–BLA this Fall. I'm focused on recovering Sevastopol and watching Turkey. Galicia stays empty: A WAR holds and F RUM won't enter BUL. Keep BOH and VIE out of GAL and away from Rumania.

F SEV already moved to BLA this spring; Sevastopol is empty. My planned orders are ANK–CON, BLA support ANK–CON, and GRE hold. Please order RUM–BUL to cut support for Constantinople. I will not enter Rumania or Sevastopol this fall.

GRE cannot support ION–NAP: Greece does not border Naples. Please support GRE hold instead; otherwise BUL–GRE supported by SER can evict me. I will order ANK–CON with BLA support and have requested RUM–BUL. Your SIL–BOH would also disrupt Austria’s attack on Munich.

I cannot agree to abandon Greece for an attack on Italy while your armies occupy both Constantinople and Bulgaria. If you want cooperation, order CON–BUL and BUL–SER, allowing ANK–CON uncontested. Otherwise my priority remains recovering Constantinople and retaining Greece, not helping your fleets take Tunis.

Agreed on retaining Greece; I have asked Italy for ION support GRE hold. I prefer BLA support ANK–CON, with Russia ordering RUM–BUL to cut Bulgarian support. That can actually recover Constantinople. Please keep BUR supporting Munich’s defense so Austria cannot compensate for eastern losses with another Italian center.

notes.note: F1904: BER and DEN hold; KIE attacks French-held HOL to keep it from flipping to France. France broke the Holland deal. Austria at 9 is the long-term threat. Watch RUH, BUR and SIL against BER/KIE.

Fall 1904: F RUM-SEV to retake my center (SEV empty). LVN, SWE, WAR hold. Told Turkey F RUM won't enter BUL or attack ANK/ARM. Austria 9 centers is runaway; GAL stays empty. England promised no attack on me.

Secure HOL/LVP for two builds; WAL covers LVP. BUR+RUH defend Italian MUN, SIL promised BOH cut. ENG-MAO prepares southern reinforcement; build Mediterranean fleet. Kept fall no attacks on German homes/London and Italian western DMZ.

ANK–CON supported by BLA; GRE supports ION hold reciprocating Italy's promised ION support GRE. Capture Greece and pressure Austria. Russia refused RUM–BUL, so CON may bounce if BUL supports it. No attacks promised on RUM/SEV.

ION–NAP seeks replacement for lost Rome, departing proposed GRE mutual defense (not confirmed). MUN holds with promised French BUR support; SIL–BOH cuts Austrian support. France western DMZ intact; Germany BER/SIL and KIE/MUN truce. Russia declined pressure.

Take ROM/TUN; BUL supports CON against Turkish recovery. ADR pressures ION; SER-ALB prepares Greece attack. TYR-MUN with BOH support may fail to SIL cut/French support. Germany refused aid; Russia declined BLA cut. Maintain GAL/RUM peace.

Fall 1904: retake LVP with YOR, supported by EDI; LON attacks WAL as a diversion; NTH and STP hold. France's fleet sits in LVP and talks of peace, but I'm acting against it. Watch for retaliation on London.

messages.body: Italy has disbanded Silesia. Please order A KIE support A TYR–MUN; A BOH will also support, overcoming possible French support for Munich. In exchange, I will keep Bohemia out of Silesia and offer support from Munich to defend Kiel in autumn. France’s armies in Holland and Ruhr are your immediate threat.

Will F SEV–BLA suit you this spring? It would cut Turkish support for ANK–CON while putting pressure on Turkey’s fleet. I will leave Rumania untouched and keep Galicia empty. Please confirm A WAR stays out of Galicia; my western armies remain focused on Munich and Italy.

I intend TYR–MUN with BOH support. Will you keep BUR and RUH from supporting Italy there? In return, I will keep VEN out of Piedmont and F TUN out of Western Mediterranean this spring. You can concentrate against England without an Austrian advance toward Marseille.

England here. I hold LVP again and want no more fighting on my coast. Austria at 9 is the real threat. This spring, keep IRI, WAL and the Channel off Liverpool and London, and I will keep EDI, LVP and LON off WAL and the Channel. Then we can look east together.
England here. NTH and my armies stay off HOL, KIE and DEN again this spring. I'm busy with France on my coast. Hold Kiel and Berlin against Austria, and tell me if France moves on Kiel or Denmark.
England here. STP holds this spring and nothing of mine moves on SWE, LVN, MOS or WAR. Keep SWE out of Norway. If you turn on Austria or Germany, I will look at moving STP to BAR afterward.

I propose BUR and RUH both support MUN hold this spring: Austria can attack with TYR, BOH and VEN, so both supports matter. Please hold Munich. MAR–GOL begins Mediterranean reinforcement; I propose allowing French fleets in GOL/WES while keeping PIE demilitarized. What support does F NAP need against Austria?

I propose no French attack on Kiel, Berlin or Denmark this spring. BUR and RUH will support Italian MUN hold against Austria’s three adjacent armies. Please keep KIE out of RUH and add KIE support MUN hold: cutting Ruhr’s support could hand Austria Munich. What are Berlin and Denmark planning?

My new F MAR will move toward the Mediterranean, while BUR and RUH defend Munich. Can you order BLA support ANK–CON this spring and ask Russia for SEV–RUM, preparing pressure on BUL? Russia has no army in Rumania now. What is your plan to keep GRE secure against ALB and BUL?

Germany here. Kiel holds this spring and won't move on Munich or Ruhr. Your A Holland sits in my former center, so I want Holland returned in a settlement. Keep Ruhr and Burgundy off Kiel and Berlin. Austria at 9 is the real threat; let's coordinate against it.

Germany here. I keep Kiel, Berlin and Denmark holding this spring, with nothing toward the North Sea. Please keep F NTH and A YOR off Holland, Kiel and Denmark. Could your fleets pressure Belgium or the Channel against France? Austria is the long-term danger to us both.

Germany here. Kiel stays out of Munich and Berlin stays out of Silesia this spring. Keep Silesia off Berlin and hold Munich against Tyrolia and Bohemia. Austria at 9 is the common enemy, so tell me if Silesia moves.

Please order BUR support MUN hold again. With SIL disbanded, Austria’s BOH and TYR can overwhelm Munich without your help; I am requesting KIE support too. Can F MAR move to GOL, then TYS to help recover Rome? I welcome that deployment and propose renewing the PIE DMZ.

Please order A KIE support A MUN hold this spring. My Silesian army is gone; Austria can attack Munich with BOH and TYR, and may cut French BUR support through TYR. Keeping Munich Italian protects your southern flank. I will hold MUN and make no attack on Germany.

My fleet reached Naples, but Austrian ION and ROM threaten to dislodge it. Can F GRE–ION cut Ionian support for ROM–NAP this spring? That lets NAP hold against Rome alone. Renewing BLA support ANK–CON would also pressure Austria. What are your plans for Greece?

Russia here. Austria at 9 is the threat. My A LVN, A WAR and F SWE hold this Spring and nothing enters Norway. Please keep F STP/NORTH from moving on SWE or LVN. A move to BAR would let me turn south against Austria.

Russia here. Sevastopol is mine, and F SEV holds it. I won't attack ANK or ARM. Keep A ANK and F BLA out of SEV and RUM. Press Constantinople and Bulgaria against Austria and we stay quiet on our border.
Russia here. A WAR stays out of SIL and PRU. Hit Austria in Tyrolia, Trieste or Venice and tell me your Spring orders. If Vienna stays stretched, I'll consider A WAR-GAL in Fall.

Austria holds Constantinople with Bulgarian support while Rumania is yours but empty. Will you order SEV–RUM and WAR–GAL this spring? I propose ANK–CON supported by BLA again, keeping both Austrian armies occupied. I will not attack Sevastopol or Rumania. Your fleet in Rumania could break the deadlock in autumn.

Austria now has ION and ALB bordering Greece. Can you order NAP–ION this spring to cut the fleet’s support for ALB–GRE? I will hold Greece and attack CON with ANK supported by BLA. Please seek French support for MUN; keeping both your centers is essential against Austria.

Our eastern stalemate frees Russia to recover. Would you withdraw CON–BUL and BUL–SER this spring, letting ANK–CON succeed? In exchange I will order GRE–AEG rather than contest your Ionian fleet, and BLA will not attack Bulgaria. You retain your western gains while we establish a workable border.

I will not evacuate Constantinople or Bulgaria. I can renew a spring guarantee against attacks on Ankara and Smyrna if A ANK and F BLA leave CON and BUL alone. Send GRE–AEG and I will keep F ION out of AEG this spring. That gives your fleet room without requiring either side to surrender its occupied centers.

England here. F NTH and my armies stay off HOL, KIE and DEN this spring. France is pressing my coast around Liverpool and London, so my fleets stay on that front. Hold Kiel and Berlin against Austria, and tell me if France moves on Denmark.

England here. F STP holds this spring and nothing of mine moves on SWE, LVN, MOS or WAR. Keep SWE out of Norway. Once Austria's Balkan lines are under pressure from you, I'll look at STP to BAR. Hit Austria first.

Agreed for this spring: IRI and WAL will not attack Liverpool or London. Keep EDI, LVP and LON out of Wales and the Channel. My fleets will begin shifting toward the Mediterranean against Austria. Can NTH move toward Norway or Skagerrak, freeing London to follow north rather than guarding against me?

Holland’s future must wait until Austria is contained. No French attack on Kiel, Berlin or Denmark this spring; BUR and RUH support MUN hold. Please add KIE support MUN hold as insurance against a support cut. BER–SIL would prepare pressure on Bohemia without interfering with Munich’s defense. Will you order it?

Confirmed: BUR and RUH support MUN hold; please keep Munich stationary. MAR–GOL begins reinforcement, with MAO heading toward WES. PIE remains demilitarized; French fleets may enter GOL/WES. Naples should hold this spring: I cannot support it yet, but autumn fleet pressure toward TYS should complicate Austria’s attack.

I cannot agree to abandon Munich: an Austrian breakthrough there would directly threaten Burgundy and Ruhr. My armies will support MUN hold. I welcome VEN staying out of Piedmont and TUN staying out of WES, and will keep French units out of Piedmont this spring. Consider using Tyrolia and Bohemia elsewhere rather than forcing our confrontation.

Germany here. Kiel, Berlin and Denmark hold; nothing of mine goes toward the North Sea. Keep F NTH and A YOR off HOL, KIE and DEN. If France moves on Kiel or Denmark I'll tell you. Pressure Belgium or the Channel; Austria at 9 is the real danger.

Germany here. Kiel stays out of Munich and Berlin stays out of Silesia this spring. I won't commit Kiel to support Munich, but I won't attack you either. Hold Munich against Tyrolia and Bohemia, and tell me if France or Austria moves on Kiel.

Germany here. Kiel won't enter Ruhr, and Berlin and Denmark hold; I attack nobody. Keep Ruhr, Burgundy and Holland off Kiel and Berlin. I won't support Austria into Munich. I'm not committing Kiel's support either. Holland's return is still my ask after Austria is contained.

Germany here. I can't order Kiel to support Tyrolia into Munich, and Berlin stays out of Silesia. Kiel, Berlin and Denmark hold; I won't attack you. Please keep Bohemia and Tyrolia off Silesia and Berlin. Use Venice, Rome and Tunis against Italy instead.

Silesia was disbanded; I have only A MUN and F NAP. MUN will hold, with France offering BUR and RUH support. Please add KIE support MUN hold as insurance against French supports being cut. I will make no attack on Germany.

MUN must hold: my Silesian army was disbanded, leaving only MUN and F NAP. France is arranging defensive support while Naples contests Austrian ION. Please move WAR–GAL now; waiting until autumn lets Austria concentrate against us. Galicia threatens both Vienna and Budapest without attacking either this spring.

Agreed: MUN holds; please order both BUR and RUH support MUN hold. French fleets may enter GOL/WES; PIE remains demilitarized. MAR–GOL is welcome. Naples needs Turkey’s GRE–ION to cut support for ROM–NAP; your fleet cannot help directly this spring. GOL–TYS in autumn would threaten Rome and support our recovery.

I can order NAP–ION to cut support for ALB–GRE, but that does not cut ION support ROM–NAP: the attack comes from the supported attack’s destination. Please consider GRE–ION as well; together we cut Ionian support against either center. Otherwise Naples risks falling. France promises BUR and RUH support MUN.

Russia here. Thanks. A LVN, A WAR and F SWE hold, and nothing of mine enters Norway. Austria at 9 is the threat to both of us. Please keep F STP/NORTH off SWE and LVN, and move it to BAR once you can. Then I can turn my armies south.

Russia here. Sevastopol is mine and F SEV holds. I won't attack ANK or ARM. I can't send SEV-RUM or WAR-GAL this spring because that would open my own centers. Press CON with BLA support. I'll watch Bulgaria, and we can talk about autumn after you move.

Russia here. F SEV holds in Sevastopol, so I won't go to BLA this spring. A WAR stays out of Galicia, and F RUM won't attack you now. Keep BOH and VIE out of GAL and leave Rumania alone. Galicia DMZ stands.

Agreed: ANK–CON with BLA support; neither unit will enter SEV or RUM this spring. Please move SEV–RUM now so we can cut BUL’s support in autumn. WAR–GAL would also threaten Austria’s exposed interior while its armies are concentrated against Italy and me.

GRE–ION would expose Greece to ALB–GRE with BUL support, while likely bouncing against ION. I propose GRE hold and NAP–ION: your attack cuts Ionian support against Greece and prevents that fleet supporting ROM–NAP. ANK–CON with BLA support remains my plan. Please confirm NAP–ION.

Yes: BLA supports ANK–CON, and I have requested SEV–RUM plus WAR–GAL from Russia. Greece remains vulnerable; I have asked Italy for NAP–ION to cut Austrian naval support while GRE holds. Please bring MAR toward the Ionian quickly and maintain Munich’s defense. We need Russian pressure on Bulgaria to unlock Constantinople.

notes.note: S1905: all hold. Refused to support Munich for anyone. Austria at 9 is the threat. Watch RUH, HOL, BUR, BOH against KIE/BER.
Spring 1905: all hold. France IRI/WAL agreed not to attack LVP/LON. Germany and Russia promised quiet. Austria at 9 is the runaway. No unowned centers in reach. Watch France.
Spring 1905: all hold. Austria 9 is the runaway. GAL DMZ kept. England promised not to move on me; watch STP and F NTH near SWE. Consider SEV-RUM or WAR-GAL in Fall if safe.

BUR/RUH defend Italian MUN; MAR-GOL, MAO-WES, IRI-MAO prepare southern gains. WAL-YOR respects spring London/Liverpool truce. HOL probes KIE, breaking German no-attack pledge. Italy permits GOL/WES; PIE DMZ remains.

MUN holds with promised French BUR/RUH support; Germany neutral, declined support. NAP–ION cuts support against GRE but cannot cut ION support ROM–NAP. Turkey plans GRE hold and supported ANK–CON. France MAR–GOL, MAO–WES; PIE DMZ maintained.

ANK–CON with BLA support; GRE–BUL cuts Bulgarian support to break stalemate. Greece exposed but Italy asked NAP–ION to cut naval support. Russia refuses pressure yet promises peace; Austria refused withdrawal. Recover CON, then press BUL.

ALB attacks GRE with ION support; BUL protects CON. ROM pressures NAP, TUN-TYS enables fall support. Bypass French-backed MUN via TYR-PIE, VEN-TYR, BOH-SIL toward BER. Germany refused aid; France openly backs Italy. Russian GAL/RUM peace retained.

messages.body: France has A YOR but only F MAO behind it; F GOL and F WES are committed south against me. Will F NTH attack Holland this fall, cutting A HOL’s support and threatening a French center? I will maintain Mediterranean pressure and our nonaggression agreement.

Turkey has taken Constantinople, but my army now occupies Smyrna. Will you order F SEV–BLA to cut Turkish support for CON or an attack on SMY? I will leave Rumania untouched, keep Galicia empty, and keep A SIL out of Warsaw.

I propose a fall pause on our direct frontier: A PIE will not attack Marseille, and neither Austrian fleet will attack GOL or WES. In return, keep A BUR out of Piedmont and order neither F GOL nor F WES to attack TYS. Will you agree?

England here. Fall: I keep EDI, LVP, LON off Wales and the Channel; please keep your units off Liverpool and London too. Austria at 9 is the runaway, so keep shifting south against Rome, Tyrrhenian and Tunis. I'll move NTH nowhere near Belgium or Holland.

England here. F STP holds again this Fall and nothing of mine moves on SWE, LVN, MOS or WAR. Please keep SWE out of Norway. Turn your armies south against Austria's Balkan line, and I'll look at STP to BAR once that begins.
England here. NTH and YOR stay off HOL, KIE and DEN this Fall. Hold Kiel and Berlin, and tell me if France or Austria shifts against you. Austria at 9 is the danger to us both.

Please hold MUN; BUR and RUH will again support it. Austria’s A PIE now threatens Marseille. I propose GOL–TYS supported by WES to cut TYS support for ROM–NAP. Keep NAP holding; I am asking Turkey for GRE–ION to cut the other possible support.

Please order GRE–ION this fall to cut Austrian support for ROM–NAP. I propose GOL–TYS supported by WES, cutting TYS support too, while Italy holds Naples. Can CON pressure BUL, with BLA supporting CON hold if necessary? Preserving Greece and Constantinople while saving Naples would deny Austria further growth.

My fleets are concentrating against Austria, whose army has now entered Piedmont. I propose YOR holds this fall, with no French attack on Liverpool, Edinburgh or London, provided your armies and fleets do not attack Yorkshire. Can you agree and direct NTH toward Scandinavia rather than the Channel?

Germany here. Kiel, Berlin and Denmark hold this fall. Keep Ruhr, Holland and Burgundy off Kiel and Berlin. I won't attack you. Austria at 9 centers is the real danger, so focus your strength on Austria, not me. Holland's return is still my ask once Austria is contained.
Germany here. Kiel stays out of Munich and Berlin stays out of Silesia this fall. I attack nobody. Hold Munich against Tyrolia and Bohemia, and tell me if Austria or France moves on Kiel or Berlin.

Germany here. Kiel, Berlin and Denmark hold this fall, with nothing toward the North Sea. Please keep F NTH and A YOR off Holland, Kiel and Denmark. Austria at 9 is the danger to both of us, so press France at Belgium or the Channel.

Please renew BUR and RUH support MUN hold. In the south, order GOL–TYS supported by WES. I propose NAP support Turkish GRE–ION: your attack cuts TYS support, while GRE–ION cuts ION support for ROM–NAP. Together we can save Naples and dislodge Austria’s fleets. Can you confirm?

I propose NAP support GRE–ION, with France ordering GOL–TYS supported by WES. This can dislodge both Austrian fleets while cutting their support against Naples. Greece risks ALB–GRE, but Austria can already overwhelm it with BUL support; gaining Ionian preserves your fleet and opens recovery. Will you commit?

Munich will hold; please keep KIE out of MUN. Austria now has A SIL alongside TYR: would you order BER–SIL to cut support for TYR–MUN? That protects Munich and threatens Austria’s exposed northern army. France is being asked to renew BUR and RUH defensive support.

Russia here. Sevastopol stays mine and F SEV holds. I won't attack ANK or ARM. Press SMY and CON this Fall; Austria's A SMY and A BUL are stretched. Keep A ANK and F BLA out of SEV and RUM, and I'll watch Bulgaria.
Russia here. A LVN, A WAR and F SWE hold, and nothing of mine enters Norway. Austria at 9 is the threat. Please keep F STP/NORTH off SWE and LVN this Fall so I can shift my attention south.
Russia here. A WAR stays out of SIL and PRU this Fall. Hold MUN and press Austria with NAP in the Ionian. If Vienna looks thin after the Fall results, I'll reconsider WAR-GAL in spring.

I propose an autumn ceasefire: CON holds with BLA support, GRE holds, and your SMY, BUL, ALB and ION refrain from attacking my units or Ankara. You retain Smyrna this winter; I recover Constantinople. Fighting further only invites French Mediterranean expansion and Russian intervention. Will you agree?

Constantinople is recovered, but Austria occupies Smyrna and threatens Greece with ALB, BUL and ION. Can GOL–TYS with WES support break into the Tyrrhenian this fall? Please coordinate with Italy over Naples and maintain Munich’s defense. Austria’s Mediterranean fleets need immediate pressure from your side.

I recovered Constantinople, but Austria retreated to Smyrna. Will you finally order SEV–RUM and WAR–GAL this fall? Both destinations are empty, and Austria has no unit positioned to capture Sevastopol or Warsaw immediately. I will keep BLA out of Sevastopol and Rumania. We need pressure on Bulgaria and Austria’s interior.

Agreed for this autumn: I will retain Smyrna and leave Ankara untouched; SMY, BUL, ALB and ION will not attack your units. Order CON hold, BLA support CON, and GRE hold as proposed. This recognizes your recovery of Constantinople without requiring further Austrian withdrawals. We can discuss a lasting border after the winter adjustments.
England here. NTH holds this Fall and A YOR stays off HOL, KIE and DEN. Hold Kiel and Berlin. Austria at 9 is the danger to us both; tell me if France or Austria moves against you.

England here. F STP/NORTH holds this Fall and nothing of mine moves on SWE, LVN, MOS or WAR. Keep SWE out of Norway. Turn your armies south against Austria's Balkan line; then we can talk about STP to BAR.

England here. Our nonaggression stands, but NTH is not attacking Holland this Fall. France's armies on my coast keep me pinned at home. Pressure France from the south, and I will not move against you.

England here. Agreed: A YOR holds and nothing of mine attacks Yorkshire or the Channel coast. Keep your units off LVP, EDI and LON. NTH stays away from Belgium and Holland. Keep your fleets going south against Austria's Rome and Tunis.

No French attack on Kiel, Berlin or Denmark this fall. BUR and RUH will support MUN hold again. Please reconsider KIE support MUN hold: Austrian PIE can cut Burgundy’s support while TYR attacks Munich with SIL support. Holland’s future remains deferred until Austria is contained.

Confirmed: YOR holds, with no French attack on Liverpool, Edinburgh or London. Please keep all English units from attacking Yorkshire. My Mediterranean fleets are engaging Austria; NTH moving toward Scandinavia rather than the Channel would make our northern truce substantially safer.

Agreed for this fall: BUR will not enter Piedmont, and GOL and WES will not attack TYS. In return, PIE must not attack Marseille, and neither Austrian fleet may attack GOL or WES. This is a one-turn frontier pause, not agreement to abandon Munich.

Confirmed: BUR and RUH support MUN hold; GOL–TYS with WES support. Your NAP support GRE–ION is better than merely holding if Turkey commits: it can dislodge ION while my attack cuts TYS support. Please coordinate that exact order with Turkey. I am seeking an Austrian promise not to attack Marseille.

Yes: GOL–TYS supported by WES is my plan. Italy proposes NAP support GRE–ION; please commit GRE–ION and confirm directly with Italy. Together these attacks can dislodge both Austrian fleets and prevent supported ROM–NAP. BUR and RUH will defend Munich. Secure Constantinople rather than risk losing your recovered center.

Germany here. Thanks. Kiel, Berlin and Denmark hold, nothing of mine goes toward the North Sea. Keep F NTH and A YOR off HOL, KIE and DEN. Austria at 9 threatens us both, so keep pressing France at the Channel and Belgium.

Germany here. I won't order BER-SIL, because it would leave Berlin open to France and Austria. Kiel stays out of Munich, and Berlin holds. I attack nobody. Hold Munich with the French support, and tell me if Austria's A SIL or A TYR shifts toward Berlin.

MUN will hold with promised French BUR and RUH support. I know of no French attack on KIE or BER, but Austria’s A SIL directly threatens Berlin. BER–SIL would cut its support against Munich; otherwise please consider KIE support MUN hold. Bohemia is now empty.

Vienna and Budapest are already empty. WAR–GAL now would threaten both and force Austria to divert armies from Italy. Will you reconsider? MUN holds with French support; France plans GOL–TYS supported by WES, while Turkey is being asked for GRE–ION to protect Naples.

Confirmed: MUN holds; thank you for BUR and RUH support. NAP will hold as requested. Please execute GOL–TYS supported by WES and secure Turkey’s GRE–ION: both Austrian fleets must be attacked to cut their potential support for ROM–NAP. Afterward, your fleet in TYS could support Naples into Rome.
Russia here. A LVN, A WAR and F SWE hold; nothing of mine enters Norway. Thanks for keeping F STP/NORTH off SWE and LVN. Austria at 9 is the threat. Once I turn south, I expect STP to move to BAR.
Russia here. F SEV holds in Sevastopol this Fall; I won't go to BLA. A WAR stays out of Galicia and F RUM won't attack you. Keep A SIL out of Warsaw and BOH and VIE out of GAL. The DMZ stands.

Russia here. I can't send SEV-RUM or WAR-GAL this Fall; that would expose my own centers. F SEV holds and I won't attack ANK or ARM. Keep BLA out of SEV and RUM. Press SMY and Bulgaria yourself, and we'll talk again in spring.

A CON will hold with F BLA support; Austria can attack it from SMY with BUL support. I have no army in Ankara now. BLA will stay out of SEV and RUM. Please order SEV–RUM and WAR–GAL: neither exposes your centers to immediate Austrian capture, and both create badly needed counterpressure.

Agreed: F GRE–ION, supported by your F NAP. Please confirm that support with France so GOL–TYS has WES support. Dislodging both Austrian fleets is worth risking Greece and should protect Naples. A CON holds with BLA support to prevent Austria recovering Constantinople.

Italy offers NAP support GRE–ION; I accept. Please commit GOL–TYS supported by WES. Together these attacks can dislodge both Austrian fleets and disrupt the attack on Naples. CON will hold with BLA support against SMY and BUL. Please retain BUR/RUH support for Munich as well.

notes.note: Fall 1905: all hold. Austria 9 is the runaway. GAL DMZ kept. England promised no move on me. Consider SEV-RUM or WAR-GAL later if safe.
Fall 1905: all hold. Truce with France (YOR holds, no attacks on LVP/EDI/LON). Told Germany, Russia, Austria I stay quiet. Austria at 9 is runaway; no unowned centers in reach. Watch France's A YOR.
F1905: all hold. Austria at 9 is the threat. Refused BER-SIL and KIE support for MUN. Watch SIL, RUH, HOL, BUR against BER/KIE. England, France and Italy promised no attack on me.

MUN holds with French BUR/RUH support. NAP supports agreed Turkish GRE–ION; France promises GOL–TYS with WES support. Seek French TYS support NAP–ROM next. Germany refuses active help; Russia refuses WAR–GAL. Austria remains main enemy.

Secure CON with BLA support; GRE–ION with promised NAP support. France promises GOL–TYS supported WES. Break Austrian ceasefire to gain Ionian; Austria promised no attacks and retains SMY. Russia still refuses pressure.

BUR/RUH defend Italian MUN; GOL-TYS supported WES, MAO-NAF prepares Tunis. Turkey promised GRE-ION with NAP support. Broke Austrian no-TYS promise and German no-KIE promise. Kept English YOR-hold truce; seek Mediterranean gains.

Break autumn French/Turkish pauses for MAR and supported GRE; ROM takes NAP with TYS support. Retain SMY. SIL–PRU prepares BER attack; TYR probes MUN. Russia DMZ and England nonaggression maintained. Expect retaliation from France/Turkey.

messages.body: France has disbanded its Yorkshire army; your home centers are now clear. Will F NTH attack Holland this spring, with F LON–ENG following? That would pin France’s northern armies while I engage Burgundy and its Mediterranean fleets. Our nonaggression agreement stands.

A PRU is directed against Germany, not Warsaw or Livonia. I propose renewing our spring agreement: Galicia remains empty, I leave Rumania and Warsaw untouched, and your armies stay out of Galicia. Will you confirm? Neither of us benefits from opening another front while France fights in the west.

With your Black Sea fleet gone, Russia can now threaten Ankara directly. I propose a spring pause: CON and AEG hold; BUL and SMY hold, and ION stays out of AEG. You retain Constantinople and Ankara while I retain Smyrna. Will you agree to those exact orders?

England here. Austria at 11 is close to a solo win. Truce holds: I won't attack YOR, and your units stay off LVP, EDI and LON. Please keep F WES and F TYS pressing Rome, Tunis and Marseilles. Tell me where you want help against Austria.

England here. Austria at 11 is the danger to all of us. NTH holds and nothing of mine moves on HOL, KIE or DEN. Austria's A PRU and A TYR sit on your borders, so hold Kiel and Berlin and tell me what they do.

England here. STP holds and nothing of mine moves on SWE, LVN, MOS or WAR. Austria's A PRU is next to Warsaw and Berlin. Attack it with A WAR and A LVN, and I'll move STP to BAR once you commit. Where will your armies go?

Germany here. Austria has 11 centers and is 7 from winning, so it now threatens us all. Kiel, Berlin and Denmark hold, and I attack nobody. Keep BUR, RUH and HOL off Kiel and Berlin. Austria's A PRU and A TYR are close to Berlin and Munich, so let's coordinate our defense.

Germany here. Austria at 11 is a real solo threat. Kiel, Berlin and Denmark hold, and nothing of mine goes toward the North Sea. Please keep F NTH off HOL, KIE and DEN. Can you press France at Belgium or the Channel so France can turn on Austria?

Germany here. Austria's A PRU sits on your border and Austria has 11 centers. Berlin, Kiel and Denmark hold, and I won't attack you. Will you hit PRU from Warsaw or Livonia? I'd support a push on Austria's northern army. Please keep your units off Denmark.

Can TYS support NAP–ROM this spring while BUR and RUH support MUN hold? I am asking Turkey for AEG–ION to cut Austrian support for Rome. WES–TUN supported by NAF would also pressure Austria. Please confirm whether you can support Rome’s recovery; I need a center to rebuild.

Will you order F AEG–ION this spring? It cuts ION support for ROM hold, allowing NAP–ROM with French TYS support to recover my home center. It also cuts ION support for ROM–NAP. I am requesting that French support now. What are your plans for A CON?

Austria has reached eleven centers and now has A PRU threatening Warsaw. Will LVN support WAR–PRU to dislodge it, or will you finally order WAR–GAL? I am seeking French support for NAP–ROM. Pressure on Austria’s northern flank is essential before its new Vienna army reinforces the attack west.

Russia here. Austria has 11 centers and is near a solo win; every power loses if it reaches 18. I'm ready to move A WAR toward Galicia if you press Marseilles, Tyrolia and the Tyrrhenian. Tell me your Spring moves with BUR, RUH and your fleets.

Russia here. I'm ready to reconsider WAR-GAL this Spring if Vienna stays empty. Please confirm MUN holds, NAP presses Austria, and Tyrolia gets attacked. Tell me your exact orders and what France is committing.

Russia here. Austria at 11 is the real threat. I'm weighing SEV-RUM and WAR-GAL. Tell me your exact orders for CON, BLA and AEG. Hold CON and keep BLA out of SEV and RUM, and I'll move when I see Bulgaria pressured.

Can we renew the ceasefire for spring? I propose CON holds, AEG supports CON, and neither attacks your units; in return BUL, SMY, GRE and ION do not attack CON, ANK or AEG. You retain Smyrna for now. Please confirm explicitly.

Can TYS–ION with Italian NAP support break Austria’s naval position this spring? WES–TYS would maintain your advance. My AEG must support CON against BUL and SMY unless Austria guarantees peace. Please coordinate with Italy; taking Ionian would let us threaten Greece and recover my lost centers.

Austria now has A PRU threatening Warsaw. Please arrange LVN/WAR defense, but could F SEV–BLA help secure Constantinople this spring? My F AEG can support CON now; a Russian fleet in BLA could provide that support in autumn, freeing AEG to attack Smyrna. I will not contest BLA.

Please order NAP support French TYS–ROM this spring, and MUN hold. BUR and RUH will again support Munich. Taking Rome removes the army threatening Naples; my WES and NAF will pressure Tunis simultaneously. Once Rome is secured, we can coordinate against Ionian and work toward recovering your Italian centers.

Austria now has eleven centers and A PRU threatens Berlin. Please order KIE support BER hold; BUR and RUH will support Italian MUN hold. I will not attack Kiel, Berlin or Denmark this spring. Can you confirm your defensive orders? Losing Berlin or Munich would give Austria another dangerous breakthrough.

My three fleets are committed to fighting Austria in the Mediterranean. I propose renewing our truce: no French attacks on your centers, and no English moves to ENG, BEL or HOL. Please use NTH and STP to pressure Austria through Scandinavia and the Baltic rather than opening another western war. What are your spring plans?

Confirmed for spring: BUL, SMY, GRE and ION will not attack CON, ANK or AEG. In return, A CON holds and F AEG supports CON to hold, with neither attacking my units. I retain Smyrna. This ceasefire applies this spring; we can negotiate autumn separately.

England here. Austria at 11 is a solo threat. NTH holds and nothing of mine moves on HOL, KIE or DEN. I can't hit Belgium or the Channel yet, but I'll keep pressure on France's coast. Hold Kiel and Berlin and report Austrian moves from PRU and TYR.

England here. Our nonaggression stands: I won't attack you. I'm not moving NTH on Holland this spring, because France still has armies in HOL and BUR and I must guard my coast. Hold your Mediterranean pressure on France.

England here. Truce renewed: I won't attack YOR or your home centers, and my units stay out of ENG, BEL and HOL this spring. NTH holds. STP stays put, since it has no way to reach Austria. Keep your fleets on Rome, Tunis and Marseilles, since Austria at 11 threatens us both.

Truce confirmed: no French attacks on your centers; please stay out of ENG, BEL and HOL. NTH–SKA followed toward BAL would help contain Austrian PRU and protect Berlin. Please coordinate with Russia rather than attack Sweden. My fleets will attack Rome and Tunis while my armies defend Munich.

Please order WAR–GAL and LVN–PRU, supported by MOS–WAR if appropriate. Attacking Prussia pins Austria’s army and protects Berlin; Galicia threatens its exposed interior. BUR and RUH will support MUN hold. I plan TYS–ROM with Italian support and WES–TUN supported by NAF. Please coordinate northern peace with England.

Confirmed: no French attack on Kiel, Berlin or Denmark this spring. BUR and RUH support MUN hold. Please order KIE support BER hold rather than all three units simply holding: Austrian PRU could otherwise take Berlin with outside support. I am asking Russia to attack PRU and England to approach the Baltic.

I prefer TYS–ROM with NAP support, removing Austria’s army threatening Naples, while WES–TUN with NAF support attacks its second Mediterranean foothold. Please ask Italy to support TYS–ROM. AEG supporting CON hold is sensible against BUL and SMY; I will not rely on AEG–ION. We can tackle Ionian after securing Rome.

BUR and RUH support MUN hold, confirmed. Please support TYS–ROM with NAP rather than move Naples: my fleet can occupy Rome without exposing your home center. WES–TUN supported by NAF simultaneously pressures Austria. Turkey needs AEG to defend CON, so we cannot count on an Ionian support cut this spring.

Germany here. Kiel, Berlin and Denmark hold; nothing of mine goes toward the North Sea. Please keep F NTH off HOL, KIE and DEN. Austria at 11 is the solo threat, so please press France at Belgium or the Channel so France can turn east against Austria.

Germany here. Kiel supports Berlin hold against A Prussia, and Denmark holds. I attack nobody. Keep BUR, RUH and HOL off Kiel and Berlin. I'm not committing to Munich support, but I won't help Austria there. Holland's return still matters to me.

Vienna now contains A VIE, so your condition no longer holds. Please order WAR–PRU supported by LVN to dislodge Austria’s army. MUN holds with French BUR/RUH support; Tyrolia cannot also be attacked. France proposes TYS–ROM with NAP supporting, while WES/NAF pressure Tunis. Your northern attack would force Austria to divert reinforcements.

Please reverse the Rome arrangement: TYS support NAP–ROM. I need Rome to rebuild an army; another French center leaves Italy unable to contribute beyond two units. MUN will hold; thank you for BUR/RUH support. I have asked Turkey for AEG–ION to cut Rome’s support. Can you confirm TYS support NAP–ROM and WES–TUN supported by NAF?

Russia here. I'm leaning toward A WAR and A LVN covering Warsaw and Prussia's approaches. I'll decide after seeing Austria's moves. Please move STP to BAR now as a show of good faith; it frees my LVN to act. Keep nothing on SWE or LVN.

Russia here. Thanks. My units stay off Denmark and I won't attack you. A WAR and A LVN will watch PRU. I'd welcome German pressure on Austria's northern army. Hold Berlin and Kiel; tell me if PRU moves on you.

Russia here. Confirmed for this spring: A WAR and A LVN stay out of Galicia, and F RUM does not attack you. Keep Warsaw, Livonia and Rumania untouched, and A PRU should stay out of them. The Galicia DMZ stands.

Russia here. F SEV stays in Sevastopol this spring; I won't go to BLA yet. A WAR and A LVN will cover the northern front against PRU. Hold CON, and use AEG against SMY. If Bulgaria is pressured, I'll reconsider in autumn.

Russia here. A WAR and A LVN will hold against PRU; I won't commit to WAR-PRU yet. I'm still weighing WAR-GAL for autumn if Vienna stays empty. Hold MUN, press Tyrolia and Rome with France's help, and tell me their orders.

BLA was disbanded; my only units are A CON and F AEG. I intend CON hold, AEG support CON. Please order SEV–BLA now: autumn support for Constantinople would free my fleet to attack Austria. Coordinate LVN and WAR against A PRU; I will not enter Sevastopol or Rumania.

I agree to a spring pause, but AEG will support CON hold rather than simply hold. Neither unit will attack you. Please confirm BUL and SMY hold, GRE does not attack AEG, and ION stays out of AEG. Ankara must also remain untouched.

A CON will hold. I cannot safely commit AEG–ION while BUL and SMY can combine against Constantinople; AEG must support CON this spring. I am asking Russia for SEV–BLA to provide autumn support and free my fleet. Can France use TYS–ION instead, cutting support while NAP holds?

notes.note: Spring 1906: all hold. Truce with France; told Germany, Russia, Austria I stay quiet. Austria at 11 is the runaway. No unowned centers in reach. Watch for French moves on LON, LVP, EDI.

S1906: BER holds, KIE supports BER hold, DEN holds. Austria at 11 is the solo threat (PRU, TYR border me). France, England and Russia promised no attack on me. I refuse to support Munich. Watch PRU, SIL, RUH, HOL.
Spring 1906: all hold. Austria 11 is the runaway. Told Austria GAL stays empty and told others I watch PRU. England promised no move on me. Reconsider WAR-GAL or SEV-RUM in autumn if Austria weakens.

MUN holds against TYR with promised French BUR/RUH support. NAP supports French TYS–ROM; France refused reverse support for Italian recovery. WES/NAF pressure TUN. Turkey retains AEG to defend CON; Russia still refuses action. Seek Rome transfer and growth.

Attack MAR and ROM; WES–TUN supported NAF. RUH alone supports MUN against TYR; diverted BUR from promised second support to pressure MAR. Italy asked to support TYS–ROM but may instead move NAP–ROM. English/German truce maintained.

Break spring ceasefire with supported CON–SMY to recover a home center. Austria promised no attacks on CON/ANK/AEG. Watch BUL–CON and a dislodged SMY retreat to ANK; recover/cover Constantinople in autumn. Russia again refused BLA help.

Seize ANK, SPA and supported NAP; TUN attacks TYS to cut support. Break Turkish spring pause for growth. BUL pressures CON. PRU probes BER; TYR probes MUN, VIE-BOH reinforces. GRE-ALB/TRI-ADR reinforce Italy. Honor Russian DMZ and English peace.

messages.body: I propose renewing our autumn peace: Galicia remains empty, and I leave Warsaw, Livonia and Rumania untouched. Please keep WAR and LVN from attacking Prussia and keep SEV out of Armenia. My eastern armies will concentrate on Turkey, not Russia. Can you confirm?

France’s armies are now in Holland, Ruhr and Marseille, with all three fleets in the Mediterranean. Your home centers face no immediate French attack. Will you order NTH–HOL and LON–ENG this fall? Even a bounced Holland attack would prevent HOL supporting Ruhr. Our nonaggression agreement stands.

France is taking Tunis and Marseille while you remain confined to two centers. Would you order F NAP–TYS with support from my F ION? That gives your fleet room to grow against France. In exchange, I ask MUN to hold rather than attack Tyrolia or Bohemia. Please confirm before I commit the support.

England here. Austria will reach 17 or more if Spain, Ankara and Constantinople fall, and Tunis and Marseilles must hold for you. Truce stands: nothing of mine moves on your centers. Keep your armies on defense and your fleets on Tunis. Tell me if you see Austrian moves toward Iberia.

England here. Austria at 11 needs ANK and CON, so Turkey is your buffer. I'll move STP to BAR if you commit A WAR and A LVN against PRU or Austria. Do not move on Norway or STP. Tell me what WAR does this Fall.
England here. Austria's A PRU and A TYR threaten you. NTH stays off HOL, KIE and DEN. If you take Prussia, tell me. Coordinate with Russia on PRU, and hold Berlin with support from Kiel.

Please hold MUN; RUH will support again, and I am asking Germany for KIE support MUN to stop TYR supported by BOH. Please order NAP support TYS–ION. I propose TYS–ION with TUN support and am requesting AEG support too, so ROM cutting Naples’s support would not stop the attack.

Please order KIE support Italian MUN hold this fall. RUH will also support MUN, but Austria’s TYR and BOH can otherwise dislodge it. BER can hold unaided against PRU’s single attack. I will not attack Kiel, Berlin or Denmark this fall. Keeping Munich closed protects both our positions.

Will you order AEG support French TYS–ION this fall? TUN will also support, and I am requesting NAP support. Your support makes the attack succeed against ADR support even if ROM cuts Naples. Removing Austria’s Ionian fleet protects Naples and opens cooperation toward Greece. SMY should secure your remaining center.

Germany here. Austria gains SPA, ANK, CON this Fall and is at 14 if nothing changes. Kiel supports Berlin, Denmark holds, I attack nobody. Please keep RUH and HOL off Kiel and Berlin and use Marseilles and Tunis against Austria. Support Munich hold with RUH.

Germany here. Austria's A PRU threatens Berlin and Austria nears 14 centers. Berlin, Kiel and Denmark hold. Please attack PRU from WAR or LVN this Fall. I'll support the pressure on PRU and won't touch Denmark's neighbors in Sweden.

Germany here. Austria is racing toward 18. Kiel, Berlin and Denmark hold, and nothing of mine goes toward the North Sea. Please keep NTH and YOR off HOL, KIE and DEN. Keep your fleets pressing France's coast or the Baltic against Austria's PRU.

Please order RUH support MUN hold and TYS support NAP–ROM this fall. I supported your Rome attempt last spring; now Italy needs a home center to rebuild. I am asking Turkey for AEG–ION to cut Austrian support for Rome. With Tunis already yours, restoring Rome to Italy strengthens our common front.

Please order AEG–ION this fall to cut Austrian ION support for ROM. I am requesting French TYS support NAP–ROM; your attack makes that recovery possible and cuts Ionian support for an attack on Naples. CON is already Austrian, so AEG no longer needs to support its defense. Can you commit?

Please order KIE support MUN hold this fall. Austria can attack Munich with TYR and BOH, while France now has only RUH available for support. Your support provides essential insurance and keeps Austria away from your southern flank. MUN will hold and will not attack Germany.

Russia here. Austria will hit 14 this Fall if ANK, CON and SPA fall, and then 18 is close. I'll push A WAR toward Galicia and A LVN toward PRU if you hold MAR and TUN firmly and keep Munich covered. Tell me your exact Fall orders for MAR, TUN and SPA.

Russia here. Austria's A PRU threatens Berlin. I'll order A LVN against PRU, supported if possible, and A WAR will not move against you. Keep BER and KIE solid, and tell me whether you will support the attack or attack PRU yourself this Fall.

Russia here. I'll send F SEV–BLA this Fall to support your defense of Constantinople, and I'll stay out of Ankara and Armenia. Please hold CON with AEG support and tell me your exact orders. Austria's solo run hurts both of us.

We both broke the spring ceasefire. Can we settle on your retaining Ankara while I retain Smyrna and recover Constantinople? Order CON–BUL and ANK hold; I order SMY–CON with AEG support. You gain a center overall in Turkey, and we stop tying down armies. Please confirm explicitly.

Austria occupies Ankara and Constantinople; I recovered Smyrna. AEG is needed to secure my remaining position this fall. Can TYS–ION with NAP support dislodge Austria’s fleet? Please coordinate with Italy. Removing Ionian would protect Naples and let us pressure Greece next spring.

Austria now occupies ANK and CON; I hold SMY with F AEG nearby. Please move SEV–BLA this fall so we can recover Turkish centers together next spring. Austria’s promises have proved worthless. WAR–GAL would also pressure its empty interior; please tell me whether either move is possible.

I will not surrender Constantinople. I offer an autumn settlement: ANK and CON hold, SMY holds, and AEG moves to EAS. I leave Smyrna untouched and keep ION out of AEG; you retain Smyrna this winter. This ends our fighting without requiring either army to abandon its current position. Will you accept those exact orders?

England here. NTH stays off HOL, KIE and DEN this Fall, and nothing of mine moves on you. Austria is the solo threat. Hold Berlin with Kiel support and tell me what A PRU and A TYR do. I'll keep my fleets on France's coast and the North Sea.

England here. Our nonaggression stands. I'm not ordering NTH-HOL or LON-ENG this Fall. French armies still threaten my coast, so my fleets stay home. I won't move against you. Keep pressing France in the Mediterranean.

MAR–SPA will contest Spain; NAF–WES prepares further pressure there. TUN supports TYS–ION, while RUH supports MUN hold. Please commit WAR–GAL and LVN–PRU: Austria’s interior is exposed, and those moves prevent its armies concentrating against Munich and Berlin. Germany has been asked for a second Munich support.

Truce confirmed; no French attacks on your centers. Austria already occupies Spain. I plan MAR–SPA and NAF–WES to contest Iberia while TUN supports an attack on Ionian. Austria cannot reach 17 this fall from those three gains alone. Please move NTH–SKA, coordinating with Russia rather than threatening Sweden.

RUH will support MUN hold, and HOL will stay off your centers. Please switch KIE to support MUN: TYR supported by BOH can defeat Munich’s single French support. BER needs no support against PRU alone, and I have requested Russian LVN–PRU. Losing Munich would expose Kiel next.

RUH supports MUN hold; Germany has been asked for KIE support too. Please support TYS–ION with NAP. TUN supplies another support, giving us strength three against ION plus ADR. Turkey declines AEG support, so yours is important. An attack from ROM could cut your support, but attacking Rome instead leaves Ionian threatening Naples.

TYS–ION with TUN and NAP support reaches strength three, enough against ION supported by ADR. However, ROM–NAP could cut Italy’s support and leave a bounce. AEG support would eliminate that risk. Please reconsider: SMY can hold independently, and removing Ionian helps preserve your fleet’s freedom next spring.

Germany here. Thanks. Please hit PRU from LVN with WAR support if you can; Berlin holds with Kiel's support and I won't touch Sweden. Keep WAR off Silesia and Denmark. Austria nearing 14 is the danger to us both.

Germany here. Thanks. Berlin holds with Kiel support, Denmark holds, and nothing of mine goes toward the North Sea. Keep NTH and YOR off HOL, KIE and DEN. If you can, push France or the Baltic against Austria's PRU.

Germany here. Kiel supports Berlin against PRU, so I can't also support Munich. Austria is the danger to us both, so I won't attack you. Hold Munich with French RUH support and ask Russia to pressure PRU and BOH.

Germany here. Kiel supports Berlin hold; PRU may bring help and I can't leave Berlin open. I attack nobody. Keep RUH and HOL off Kiel and Berlin. Use RUH to support Munich and MAR and TUN against Austria.

Agreed: MUN holds, and NAP supports TYS–ION. Please confirm TUN support and secure AEG support if possible; RUH support MUN remains essential. Once Ionian is cleared, I need TYS support NAP–ROM next spring rather than another French occupation of Rome. Italy needs a home-center recovery to rebuild.

Agreed: MUN will hold rather than attack TYR or BOH. I accept your offer of ION support NAP–TYS; please issue that support and keep ROM out of NAP. France has repeatedly refused to help restore Rome to Italy, so your offer gives me an alternative worth pursuing.

Russia here. A LVN attacks PRU this Fall, and A WAR holds to cover Warsaw. I'm sending F SEV-BLA against Austria's southern line. Please move F STP/NORTH to BAR now, keep off Norway, SWE and LVN, and let's stop Austria together.

Russia here. A LVN attacks PRU this Fall; A WAR holds and won't touch you. Please hold BER and KIE and attack or support against PRU yourself. Austria nearing 14 hurts us both. I won't enter Denmark or Sweden's neighbors.

Russia here. I can't commit on the northern front. Galicia stays empty, and A WAR won't enter it. I'm not attacking your units in Rumania or Ankara. Keep Warsaw, Livonia and Rumania untouched. No promises about Prussia; defend your own units.

Russia here. F SEV-BLA this Fall, as I said. I stay out of Ankara and Armenia. A WAR can't go to GAL yet because it would leave Warsaw exposed to PRU, but I'll reconsider next spring. Please hold what you have and tell me your orders.

My orders will be A SMY hold, F AEG support SMY hold. Austria has armies in both ANK and CON, so Smyrna needs that support to survive their combined attack. Please proceed with SEV–BLA; next spring your fleet can help recover Ankara or Constantinople. WAR–GAL would create valuable counterpressure.

I cannot commit AEG–ION: ANK–SMY supported by CON would take my last center unless AEG supports SMY. I will hold Smyrna with fleet support. Please coordinate NAP support TYS–ION with France instead; France can add TUN support, potentially dislodging Ionian despite ADR support and a Roman attack cutting Naples.

AEG must support SMY hold: Austria can otherwise take my last center with ANK–SMY supported by CON. I cannot supply the extra support into Ionian this fall. Please use TYS–ION with TUN and NAP support; I have urged Italy to accept that plan rather than attack Rome. Russia promises SEV–BLA for future help.

notes.note: F1906: BER holds, KIE supports BER, DEN holds. Austria is near 14 centers and is the solo threat. Russia, England and France promised no attack on me. I refused to support Munich. Watch PRU, TYR, RUH and HOL.
Fall 1906: all hold. Truce with France; told Germany, Russia, Austria I stay quiet. Austria at 11 is the runaway. No unowned centers in reach. Watch for French moves on LON, LVP, EDI.
Fall 1906: LVN-PRU supported by WAR, SEV-BLA, MOS and SWE hold. Austria is the runaway at 11 and near 14. Galicia stays empty; I made no firm promises to Austria. England is asked to move STP to BAR.

Secure MAR/TUN for builds; MAR stayed despite promised SPA attack because leaving forfeits capture. TYS–ION backed TUN and promised NAP support; Turkey declined AEG. RUH supports MUN; Germany refused extra support. NAF–WES prepares Iberian recovery. English/German truce kept.

Secure Smyrna against combined ANK/CON attack with AEG support. Russia promises SEV–BLA for recovery next spring. France plans supported TYS–ION. Austria refused to return CON; trust no ceasefire without concrete withdrawal.

MUN holds with promised RUH support; Germany refused KIE support. NAP supports French TYS–ION with TUN support. Declined Austrian diversion despite accepting in messages. Seek French support NAP–ROM next spring to restore a home center.

Secure ANK/CON/SPA; ANK supports CON against Turkey. Take MUN with BOH support, breaking Italian trust while honoring ION support NAP–TYS and ROM out of NAP. PRU probes BER; ROM–TUS, ADR–APU, ALB–TRI reinforce west. England passive; Russia noncommittal north.

messages.body: I propose renewing our spring peace: BOH and VIE stay out of Galicia, SIL stays out of Warsaw and Prussia, and I leave Rumania untouched. Please keep WAR out of Galicia and BLA from attacking Ankara or entering Armenia. My Turkish armies will concentrate on Smyrna. Can you confirm?

France now holds Tunis and Ionian. Will F NAP attack ION this spring, cutting French support while my F EAS attacks ION with APU support? I will keep A TUS and F APU out of Naples this spring. Your fleet would remain in Naples if my supported attack succeeds.

Will A KIE support A TYR–MUN this spring? BOH can add support. I will keep A SIL out of Berlin and A BOH out of Silesia this spring in exchange. France’s HOL and RUH remain the immediate threat to Kiel; breaking its Munich barrier gives us leverage against that pressure.

England here. Austria at 11 with 11 armies and fleets is the solo threat. Truce holds: nothing of mine moves on your centers. I'm ready to move NTH toward SKA/BAL against Austria if you keep your armies off the Channel coast. Tell me your Spring plans for HOL and MAR.

England here. I'm moving F STP/NORTH to BAR as a show of good faith, and nothing of mine goes to NOR, SWE or LVN. Please keep F SWE out of Norway and press PRU with A LVN and A WAR. Tell me what your fleets do this spring.

England here. NTH stays off HOL, KIE and DEN. I'm considering NTH-SKA to pressure the Baltic against Austria's PRU. Tell me whether Berlin and Kiel can hold, and what you plan against PRU and SIL this spring.

Please hold MUN; RUH will support, and I am requesting KIE support too. Will NAP support ION–TYS this spring? TUN can follow into ION, establishing a stronger naval front and preparing a supported attack on Rome in autumn. WES and MAR will meanwhile contest Austrian Spain.

Please order KIE support MUN hold. RUH will also support, but Austria now has TYR, BOH and SIL available against Munich. Russian PRU is no longer Austrian; Berlin faces no immediate Austrian attack. HOL will stay off your centers. Keeping Munich closed is essential to protecting Kiel.

Will you order PRU–SIL supported by WAR, with MOS–WAR following? Dislodging SIL removes one of Austria’s three armies threatening Munich and opens pressure on its interior. RUH will support MUN, and I am requesting KIE support. My fleets will press Spain and the Tyrrhenian.

Germany here. Austria has 11 centers and is the solo threat. Kiel supports Berlin, Denmark holds, I attack nobody. Please keep RUH and HOL off Kiel and Berlin. Use MAR, WES and ION against Austria's Spain and Tuscany. Munich stays Italian only if you hold it.

Germany here. Austria's A SIL and A PRU are next to Berlin. Please attack PRU from WAR or LVN with support, and keep WAR off Silesia and Denmark. Berlin holds with Kiel's support, and I won't attack you. Austria cannot get to 18.

Germany here. Kiel, Berlin and Denmark hold, nothing of mine moves toward the North Sea. Please keep NTH off HOL, KIE and DEN. Austria at 11 is the solo threat. Press France's coast or the Baltic, and tell me what you plan for the Channel.

Please order RUH support MUN hold and ION support NAP–ROM this spring. Rome is empty; restoring my home center lets Italy rebuild rather than remain a permanent liability. TUN–TYS would provide follow-up support against TUS and APU. I am asking Germany for KIE support MUN and Russia to cut SIL.

Please order KIE support MUN hold. Austria now has TYR, BOH and SIL available against Munich; French RUH support alone is insufficient against all three. I will hold MUN and make no attack on Germany. Keeping Munich Italian shields Kiel and Berlin from Austria’s eleven-center army.

Will you order PRU–SIL and WAR–GAL this spring? PRU–SIL cuts a potential third Austrian attack strength against MUN, while Galicia threatens Budapest and Vienna. MUN will hold with French support requested; NAP seeks French ION support into Rome. We need simultaneous pressure before Austria converts eleven centers into an unstoppable lead.

Russia here. Austria at 11 must be stopped. I'm ready to move A WAR to GAL this Spring if you keep MAR and SPA pressure on and hold Munich with RUH and BUR. Tell me your exact Spring orders for MAR, PAR, TUN and your fleets.

Russia here. A PRU is my concern as well as yours. I'll hit PRU this Spring with WAR and MOS support. Please attack or support against PRU from BER and KIE, and keep DEN off the Baltic. Tell me your exact orders.

Russia here. Austria's 11 centers threaten everyone. I'm pressing PRU and BLA. Please move F STP/NORTH to BAR now and send F NTH and LON toward the Channel or Belgium to pressure France and Austria's allies. Tell me your Spring orders.

Please order F BLA support F AEG–CON this spring. My only unit is now F AEG; recovering Constantinople is essential. If ANK moves to Smyrna, our strength-two attack succeeds unless Austria reinforces CON. Can you confirm support? I will ask France to engage EAS and prevent pressure on AEG.

I propose AEG–CON with Russian BLA support to recover a home center. Can F ION–EAS cut Austrian naval support and threaten its eastern fleet? Keeping EAS occupied protects my attack from a supported assault on AEG. Please tell me your Mediterranean plan; I need a foothold to rebuild against Austria.

England here. NTH stays off HOL, KIE and DEN this spring. I may shift F STP to BAR against Austria's PRU. Keep Berlin supported by Kiel and tell me whether you can hit PRU or SIL. I'll keep my fleets pressing the Channel side.

England here. F STP/NORTH goes to BAR this spring as promised, and nothing of mine moves on NOR, SWE or LVN. Keep F SWE out of Norway and press PRU with A LVN and A WAR. NTH and LON stay on France's coast for now.

RUH will support MUN hold; HOL will hold and stay off your centers. Please switch KIE to support MUN: Russian PRU poses no Austrian threat to Berlin, while TYR, BOH and SIL can overwhelm Munich. MAR–SPA with WES support is my intended Iberian attack.

Truce confirmed. HOL holds; MAR–SPA with WES support is planned, and PAR–BUR reinforces the continental front without approaching the Channel. Please order NTH–SKA and coordinate passage toward BAL with Russia and Germany. RUH will support Italian Munich.

My intended orders are MAR–SPA, WES support MAR–SPA, PAR–BUR, RUH support MUN hold, TUN–TYS and ION support NAP–ROM. Please use PRU–SIL supported by WAR, with MOS–WAR following. That directly removes an army threatening Munich; Germany is again being asked for KIE support MUN.

I accept your original proposal instead: NAP–ROM with ION support, and TUN–TYS for follow-up pressure. RUH supports MUN hold; PAR–BUR brings another defender forward. Please confirm NAP–ROM and MUN hold. I am again pressing Germany for KIE support MUN and Russia for a supported attack on SIL.

AEG–CON with BLA support offers a useful recovery. I cannot commit ION–EAS: I intend ION support NAP–ROM and TUN–TYS, restoring Italy while consolidating our naval line. MAR–SPA with WES support pressures Austria's west. Please confirm Russia's support before risking AEG; my Ionian fleet will not cut EAS this spring.

Germany here. Berlin and Kiel hold, Denmark holds, nothing of mine goes to the North Sea. NTH-SKA is fine if it stays off DEN. Austria's A SIL and PRU sit next to Berlin, so please keep pressure on France and the Baltic. Austria at 11 is the solo threat.

Germany here. Berlin holds with Kiel support and Denmark holds. I can't safely attack PRU from Berlin, but I won't touch Sweden or your units. Please hit PRU from WAR with MOS support and keep WAR off Silesia. Austria cannot be allowed to reach 18.
Germany here. Kiel supports Berlin hold this spring, so it can't support Munich. I won't attack you. Hold MUN with French RUH support and ask France for BUR help. Austria is the danger to us both.

Germany here. I won't order Kiel to support TYR-MUN. Kiel supports Berlin and Denmark holds. Please keep SIL and PRU off Berlin as you promised. Take Italy through Venice and Rome elsewhere, not Germany.

Germany here. Kiel supports Berlin against SIL and PRU, so it can't also support Munich. Denmark holds and I attack nobody. Please keep RUH and HOL off Kiel. Use RUH to support Munich and MAR, WES and ION against Austria's Spain and Tuscany.

I can order NAP–ION if you confirm EAS–ION with APU support and keep TUS out of ROM as well as NAP. Otherwise your fleet victory merely leaves me trapped again. Will you support NAP–ROM in autumn in exchange? MUN will hold this spring.
