MUN will hold; RUH support remains essential. Austria requests NAP–ION while EAS–ION receives APU support. I will not assist that attack. But Italy needs recovery: please support NAP–ROM now and order TUN–TYS. If you insist on ION–TYS, will you explicitly commit TYS support NAP–ROM in autumn?

Russia here. A PRU is attacked this Spring: A WAR supports my move into PRU, with MOS covering Warsaw. Please bring A BER and A KIE against PRU or SIL, and keep F DEN away from the Baltic. I won't touch Denmark or Berlin.

Russia here. F BLA and PRU pressure continue. F SWE stays out of Norway. Please move F STP/NORTH to BAR as promised and send F NTH and F LON to the Channel and Belgium. Austria at 11 is everyone's danger.

Russia here. PRU is pressed this Spring with WAR support and MOS covering Warsaw. I'm still wary of WAR-GAL, since it leaves Warsaw open. Hold MUN and press Tyrolia and Rome with France. Tell me your exact orders.

Russia here. Confirmed in principle: WAR stays out of Galicia, F RUM doesn't attack you. I can't promise on PRU or Silesia; defend yourself there. Keep Warsaw, Livonia and Rumania untouched, and BOH and VIE out of Galicia.

Russia here. I can't commit F BLA to support AEG-CON; Austria's armies are too close to Sevastopol. I'll stay out of Ankara and Armenia and keep pressure on Austria in the north. Ask France to engage EAS. Tell me your final orders.

Russia here. I'll press PRU this Spring: A WAR supports the attack, and MOS covers Warsaw. WAR-GAL waits until Warsaw is safe. Please keep RUH and BUR on Munich, press MAR, SPA and the Tyrrhenian, and get Germany to hit SIL or PRU too.

notes.note: Spring 1907: NTH-SKA and STP-BAR to pressure Austria; others hold. Truce with France. Austria at 11 is the runaway; watch for Russian moves on STP and NOR.
S1907: BER holds, KIE supports BER, DEN holds. Austria at 11 is the solo threat. Refused to support Munich or TYR-MUN. Russia attacks PRU from WAR. Watch SIL, PRU, RUH, HOL.
Spring 1907: PRU-SIL supported by WAR; MOS, SWE, BLA hold. Austria at 11 is the runaway. Told Austria WAR stays out of GAL. England says F STP goes to BAR. Watch Warsaw.

MUN holds against Austrian attack with promised French RUH support; Germany again refused KIE support. NAP–ROM with promised French ION support; TUN–TYS follows. Secure Rome through Fall and recover Naples if needed. Austria's anti-French offer declined.

MAR–SPA supported WES; PAR–BUR, RUH defends MUN. TUN–TYS; ION–GRE seeks Austrian center: promised NAP–ROM support is geographically impossible. HOL respects truce. Russia promised PRU–SIL with WAR support; Germany refused MUN support.

AEG–GRE targets an undefended Austrian center; stay through Fall to capture and rebuild. Russia refused BLA support AEG–CON; France declined ION–EAS and plans ION support NAP–ROM. Seek French support to secure Greece; watch CON–BUL and EAS–AEG.

Take POR, SMY and heavily supported MUN; EAS–ION with APU support. TUS–PIE pressures MAR; TRI–VEN, VIE–TRI reinforce. Watch Russian BLA–ANK and recover in fall if needed. Italy may cut ION; Germany refused support. Preserve Russian Galicia peace.

messages.body: France is taking Naples from you. Will F ROM support my F APU–NAP this fall? F ION can add support, overcoming French support from TYS. In exchange, I will leave Rome untouched this fall and keep BOH and TYR out of Munich. You retain both Rome and Munich rather than losing another center to France.

GAL was a forced retreat after your Silesian attack, not an intended opening against Warsaw. I propose GAL–BOH this fall, leaving Warsaw and Rumania untouched, if WAR stays out of GAL and BLA neither attacks Ankara nor enters Armenia. Can you confirm those terms? My priority remains France and the Mediterranean.

England here. Austria is at 11 and POR and SMY would take it to 13. Truce stands: nothing of mine moves on your centers. Keep SPA and NAP pressure on Austria and tell me your Fall orders for HOL and the Channel. I'll keep my fleets on the northern seas.
England here. F BAR and F SKA stay clear of NOR, SWE and STP. Keep F SWE out of Norway and press Austria through PRU and SIL. Tell me your Fall orders for SWE, BLA and WAR.
England here. F SKA stays off DEN and nothing of mine moves on KIE or HOL. Hold Berlin and Kiel. Tell me your Fall orders against Austria's SIL and PRU, and whether Denmark is secure.

Please hold Munich; RUH will support it. At sea, propose ROM support French NAP hold; NAP will support ROM hold, and TYS will also support NAP. This protects both centers against ION/APU while you recover Rome. BUR must cover Marseille against Austrian PIE.

Please order WAR–GAL and SIL–BOH: pressure on Austria’s interior and cutting Bohemia’s support help preserve Munich. RUH supports MUN while BUR covers Marseille. Can BLA support Turkish AEG–CON? Recovering Constantinople denies Austria a center and keeps Turkey alive; please coordinate directly with Turkey.

Please seek Russian BLA support for AEG–CON this fall. Austria’s CON can receive SMY support, but a supported attack at least pins both armies; if SMY moves, you recover a center. My NAP/TYS fleets must protect Naples and Italian Rome against ION/APU, so I cannot provide eastern naval support.

Germany here. Austria's A GAL and A BOH sit near Silesia and Berlin. Berlin holds with Kiel support, Denmark holds, and I won't touch Sweden or Warsaw. Please keep WAR off Silesia and Berlin, and tell me your Fall orders against Austria.

Germany here. Kiel supports Berlin and can't support Munich. Please keep RUH and HOL off Kiel. Austria wins Portugal and Smyrna this Fall unless you stop it. Use SPA, WES and TYS against Austria, not Germany.

Germany here. Berlin, Kiel and Denmark hold. Please keep NTH and SKA off Denmark and Kiel. Austria is at 11 and reaches 13 this Fall. Press France's coast or the Baltic against Austria, and tell me your Fall orders.

Rome recovered as agreed; please order TYS support ROM hold and NAP–APU to cut Austrian support for ION–ROM. I need Naples returned, not annexed: can you commit to vacating it? Please also order BUR and RUH support MUN hold; Austria still has BOH and TYR poised against Munich.

Please order AEG–ION this fall. Your attack cuts ION support for APU–ROM, helping secure my recovered home center. I am asking France for TYS support ROM hold and NAP–APU to cut the other fleet’s support. Smyrna is already occupied by Austria; disrupting Ionian now preserves our chances of recovery.

Thank you for driving Austria out of Silesia. Will you order SIL–BOH this fall to cut support against Munich, and WAR–GAL with MOS–WAR behind it? Galicia threatens both Warsaw and our central front. MUN will hold with French support requested; ROM holds while France and Turkey are asked to disrupt APU and ION.

Russia here. Austria needs 7 more centers and is far ahead. Keep A SPA and F WES on Spain and push F NAP and F TYS against Rome so Austria can't hold it. Tell me your exact Fall orders. I'll keep pressing Silesia and Prussia from the north.

Russia here. Austria's A BOH and A TYR threaten Munich. Hold BER and KIE, and use F DEN or A KIE to support Munich or hit Silesia. I won't touch Berlin, Denmark or Kiel this Fall. What are your exact orders?

Russia here. Austria at 11 threatens everyone. Keep F BAR and F SKA off Sweden and Norway, and I'll keep F SWE off Norway. Send F LON and A LVP toward the Channel and Belgium to pressure France's ally Austria in the west. Tell me your Fall orders.

Please order F BLA support F AEG–CON this fall. This is my last chance to retain a center and survive. Austria has no army in Ankara now; your support defeats CON hold unless SMY supports it. A WAR–GAL would also cut support for Austria’s northern attacks. Can you confirm?

I need a center this fall or Turkey disappears. Will you order F TYS–ION with F NAP support? Dislodging ION prevents its supported attack on AEG and lets me attempt Constantinople with Russian support. Please confirm; otherwise an unsupported AEG–GRE may be my only chance.

Will you allow Turkey to survive as a single fleet? Order A CON–BUL and A SMY hold; I order F AEG–CON, leaving Smyrna to you. You retain Ankara and Smyrna while I regain one center. In exchange I will target French fleets next spring rather than your centers. Can you confirm those exact orders?

I will not surrender Constantinople. I offer survival through Tunis instead: order AEG–ION this fall; I will order ION–TUN, leaving AEG and Smyrna unattacked. If Tunis succeeds, I can support your fleet onward against France next year. A CON and A SMY will hold this fall.

England here. F SKA stays off DEN and nothing of mine moves on KIE or HOL. Austria reaches 13 this Fall unless you hold. Keep Berlin, Kiel and Denmark in place and tell me if SIL or PRU move on Berlin. I'll keep pressure on the Baltic.

England here. F BAR and F SKA stay off NOR, SWE and STP. Keep F SWE out of Norway and hit Austria through PRU and SIL. My F LON and A LVP stay home to guard against France for now. Tell me what BLA and WAR do.

Truce confirmed. HOL holds; none of my units will enter the Channel or attack your centers. SPA holds with WES support, BUR covers Marseille, and NAP/TYS defend the Italian front. Please coordinate SKA–BAL with Germany and Russia rather than contest Sweden.

HOL holds and RUH supports Italian MUN; neither attacks Kiel. Please reconsider KIE support MUN hold: Berlin faces no adjacent Austrian army, whereas BOH and TYR threaten Munich now. SPA holds with WES support; BUR must cover Marseille against PIE.

Rome is now Italian; attacking it would help Austria. My intended orders remain SPA hold, WES support SPA, BUR–MAR, RUH support MUN, HOL hold, NAP support ROM hold, TYS support NAP hold. Please use SIL–BOH to cut Austrian support, WAR–GAL, and BLA support Turkish AEG–CON.

I cannot vacate Naples safely this fall: NAP–APU could bounce while leaving Naples exposed to ION. Please order ROM support NAP hold; I intend NAP support ROM hold and TYS support NAP hold. RUH supports MUN; BUR–MAR blocks PIE. Naples' eventual return remains negotiable, but I cannot promise a date.

I cannot commit TYS–ION: APU can support ION, so NAP support alone may only bounce, while exposing Naples. I have again asked Russia for BLA support AEG–CON. That is your best coordinated recovery attempt; please confirm it directly with Russia. My fleets will defend Naples and Italian Rome.

Germany here. Berlin holds with Kiel support, and Denmark holds. Nothing of mine goes toward NTH, SKA or HOL. Austria gets Portugal, Smyrna and maybe more this Fall, so please keep your fleets and LVP/EDI off my coast and press France or Austria. Tell me your exact Fall orders.

Germany here. Berlin and Kiel hold, and Denmark holds. I won't touch Sweden, Warsaw or Berlin's neighbors. Austria is at 11 and heading higher, so we must stop it. Please keep WAR off Silesia and Berlin, and tell me your exact orders. Munich is Italy's; I can't safely leave Kiel.

I cannot help replace a French fleet in Naples with an Austrian one while your fleets surround Rome. If you want cooperation, offer APU support ROM–NAP next spring and withdraw ION from Italy. For this fall, please keep BOH and TYR out of Munich; attacking it only deepens our conflict.

Agreed: MUN holds, and ROM supports NAP hold. Please confirm NAP supports ROM hold, TYS supports NAP hold, and RUH supports MUN hold. This secures our line this fall, but Naples must return to Italy: will you commit to NAP–ION with ROM and TYS support next spring, freeing Naples for my return?

Russia here. F SWE holds and stays off Norway. I expect BAR and SKA to stay off SWE, NOR and STP. Please send F LON and A LVP toward the Channel and Belgium against Austria's western holdings. A WAR and BLA hold on the southern front.
Russia here. I won't touch BER, KIE or DEN. Hold them and use F DEN or A KIE to support Munich or hit Silesia. Austria is at 11 and the real danger to both of us. Please keep your units off Sweden.
Russia here. I'll keep pressure on Austria from the north with SIL and WAR. Warsaw can't be left empty, so WAR-GAL is unlikely this turn. Hold MUN and ROM, and coordinate with France on NAP and ION.
Russia here. I can't commit F BLA to support AEG-CON. Austria's fleets and armies are too close to Sevastopol, so BLA holds. I'll stay off Ankara and Armenia. Try to get France to engage EAS. Sorry.
Russia here. Confirmed on WAR: it stays out of GAL this fall, and F RUM won't attack you. I can't promise on BLA, though I'm not moving on Ankara. Keep Warsaw and Rumania untouched.

Russia here. I can't send WAR-GAL, because it leaves Warsaw open. SIL stays pressed. BLA can't support AEG-CON; it holds to guard Sevastopol. Please hold SPA with A SPA and F WES, and push NAP and TYS against Rome to stop Austria.

I need a supply center this fall or Turkey is eliminated; AEG–ION cannot save me. I must attempt Greece or Constantinople. Please arrange TYS support ROM hold and NAP–APU with France. If Russia supports AEG–CON, that attack can also cut Constantinople’s support for an Austrian move toward Greece.

I will seek BLA support for AEG–CON, but Russia has repeatedly refused. Without it, AEG–GRE against empty Greece is my best survival chance. Please coordinate TYS support ROM hold and NAP–APU with Italy. I cannot sacrifice my final fleet cutting Ionian when Smyrna’s loss otherwise eliminates Turkey this winter.

notes.note: F1907: BER holds, KIE supports BER, DEN holds. Austria at 11 is the solo threat. Refused to support Munich again. Watch SIL, RUH, HOL, PRU.
Fall 1907: BLA-BUL, SIL-PRU, MOS, SWE and WAR hold. Austria at 11 is the runaway. Kept WAR out of GAL as promised to Austria. Turkey, France and Italy asked for BLA support or WAR-GAL; I refused.

MUN holds with promised French RUH support. ROM supports NAP hold; France promises NAP support ROM and TYS support NAP. Capture Rome; press France to vacate Naples next spring with ROM/TYS supporting NAP–ION. Austria remains main threat.

Secure SPA/NAP; SPA supports BUR–MAR against PIE. WES–MAO prepares Portugal recovery. RUH defends Italian MUN; NAP supports ROM, TYS supports NAP; Italy agreed ROM supports NAP. English/German truces kept. No firm promise to return Naples next spring.

Fall 1907: LON to ENG to threaten BRE/BEL/POR later, others hold. Truce with France is shaky. Austria at 11 heading to 13; hit French or Austrian western centers next. Keep BAR and SKA off NOR, SWE and STP conflicts.
AEG–BUL seeks survival by capturing empty Bulgaria. Austria promised CON and SMY hold, ION–TUN; Russia refused BLA support again. If successful, seek support to recover Constantinople and rebuild.

Take POR/SMY; attack MUN with TYR support, probe MAR/NAP/TUN. GAL takes empty RUM, breaking Russian peace for growth. CON defended by SMY. VEN–TUS and TRI–VEN prepare Rome recovery. Italy refused Naples support; Turkey offered CON demand, rejected.

messages.body: I offer F APU support F ROM–NAP this spring, with F TUN–TYS cutting French support. That can restore Naples to you immediately. In return, please keep A MUN holding rather than attacking BOH or TYR. Will you order ROM–NAP?

With Turkey eliminated, I propose stabilizing our frontier this spring: RUM stays out of SEV and UKR, BUD stays out of GAL, and your WAR stays out of GAL. Please also keep MOS out of SEV. I want to concentrate against France rather than open an eastern war. Can you agree?

Our nonaggression stands. Will you order F ENG–BRE this spring? France has no unit in Brest or Paris, and MAO is its only immediate defender. Even a bounce ties down that fleet while I pressure the Mediterranean. Your home armies can continue guarding Britain.

England here. Austria at 13 needs 5 more and you hold the western front. My F ENG stays off BRE and BEL if your armies stay off the Channel coast. Tell me your Spring orders for SPA, HOL and MAR, and let's both push Austria back from Iberia.

England here. F BAR and F SKA stay off NOR, SWE and STP this Spring. Keep F SWE out of Norway. Austria at 13 is the danger to us both, so hit PRU and SIL with A WAR. Tell me your orders for A MOS and F SWE.

England here. F SKA stays off DEN and nothing of mine moves on KIE or HOL. Austria at 13 is the threat to us all. Tell me if A BER or A KIE are being attacked from SIL or PRU, and I will watch the Baltic.

Please hold MUN with RUH support. I cannot safely promise NAP–ION now: TUS–ROM supported by APU could take Rome if ROM supports our move. Propose NAP supports ROM hold, ROM supports NAP hold, and TYS supports NAP hold again. Naples' return remains negotiable, but preserving both centers comes first.

Austria has 13; our truce remains essential. I plan SPA–POR supported by MAO to recover Portugal. Please move ENG–NTH rather than threaten French centers, and coordinate SKA–BAL with Germany and Russia. Can you confirm no attacks on BEL, HOL or my home centers this year?

Please order KIE support Italian MUN hold. RUH will also support MUN; HOL stays off your centers. Austria has BOH and TYR adjacent to Munich, while no Austrian unit borders Berlin. Your extra support frees us from a fragile defense and blocks Austria's route toward Kiel. Will you confirm?

Germany here. Austria has 13 and needs 5 more. Russia's PRU is now yours; please keep WAR and PRU off Berlin and Silesia. I won't touch Sweden or Warsaw. Berlin and Kiel hold, Denmark holds. Tell me your exact Spring orders.

Germany here. Austria at 13 is a real solo threat, with PIE, TUS, APU and VEN next to your coast. Keep HOL and RUH off Kiel. Use MAR, TYS and NAP against Austria. If you keep Munich closed, I won't attack you.

Germany here. Austria at 13 is the solo threat. Keep SKA and ENG off Denmark and Kiel. Berlin, Kiel and Denmark hold, and I attack nobody. Please press France's coast or Austria's fleets, and tell me your Spring orders.

Please renew RUH support MUN hold. For Rome, NAP support ROM hold and TYS support NAP hold still secures our line against TUS/APU. I will reciprocate with ROM support NAP hold. Can we arrange Naples’ return in autumn? Austria has no fleet in ION now; please outline a naval advance that restores Italian growth.

Please order KIE support MUN hold this spring. Austria has BOH and TYR poised against Munich, and VEN could reinforce TYR. French RUH support is requested, but your additional support insures against escalation. Russian PRU is not Austrian; please negotiate Berlin’s safety with Russia rather than leave our southern barrier vulnerable.

Austria has thirteen centers. Please order WAR–GAL, MOS–WAR and PRU–SIL this spring. This keeps Warsaw covered while threatening Budapest and Vienna and approaching BOH. Munich holds with French support requested. Austria’s BUD army will otherwise march west unopposed; concrete eastern pressure is essential now.

Russia here. I'm not moving on Austria this spring. A WAR stays out of Galicia and I leave Rumania and Ankara alone. Please keep BOH and VIE off Galicia and your armies off Warsaw and Prussia. I'd like us to stay at peace.

Russia here. F SWE stays off Norway, and I expect BAR and SKA to stay off SWE, NOR and STP. Austria at 13 is dangerous to us both. Please send F ENG and A LVP against France's Belgium and Brittany, and tell me your Spring orders.

Russia here. Austria at 13 needs 5 more centers. Keep A SPA and F WES on Spain, and hold HOL and MAR. Which Austrian units are you attacking, TUN or the Mediterranean ones? Tell me your exact Spring orders. I'm staying north and watching Warsaw.

Agreed: A BOH and A BUD stay out of Galicia, and my armies will not attack Warsaw or Prussia this spring. A RUM stays out of SEV and UKR. Please confirm A MOS stays out of SEV as well; that would let me concentrate reinforcements toward Italy rather than our frontier.

England here. F SKA stays off DEN and nothing of mine moves on KIE or HOL. Austria at 13 is the solo threat. Hold Berlin, Kiel and Denmark, and tell me at once if A SIL or A PRU move on BER. I'll watch the Baltic.

England here. F BAR and F SKA stay off NOR, SWE and STP. F ENG is watching France but I won't commit against BEL or BRE this turn. Austria at 13 is the danger, so hit PRU with A WAR and keep F SWE out of Norway.
England here. Our nonaggression stands. F ENG stays put and does not go to BRE this spring, because I must guard my coast and my home armies stay in Britain. Nothing of mine moves on you.

England here. I confirm no attacks this year on BEL, HOL, BRE or PAR. F ENG holds and does not enter your home centers. Go ahead with SPA-POR against Austria. SKA stays quiet, and I'll keep my northern fleets off Denmark and Kiel.

HOL holds and RUH supports Italian MUN hold; neither attacks Kiel. Please confirm KIE support MUN hold rather than Berlin: BOH and TYR threaten Munich, and no Austrian army borders Berlin. MAR holds against PIE while SPA–POR, supported by MAO, contests Austria’s western foothold.

SPA–POR with MAO support; HOL and MAR hold. No French attacks on your centers are planned. Please order ENG–NTH and SKA–BAL, coordinating passage with Germany and Russia. Your fleet leaving ENG would let us concentrate fully against Austria. Please confirm BEL, HOL and French home centers remain safe from English attack.

Planned orders: SPA–POR, MAO supports SPA–POR, MAR holds, HOL holds, RUH supports MUN hold, NAP supports ROM hold, TYS supports NAP hold. WES is now MAO; Rome is Italian. Please order WAR–GAL and PRU–SIL, with MOS–WAR. Austria has no army in Silesia: these moves create real pressure on its exposed interior.

Confirmed: RUH supports MUN hold, NAP supports ROM hold, TYS supports NAP hold. Please reciprocate ROM support NAP hold. For autumn, NAP–ION with TYS support could free Naples for ROM–NAP, provided Tuscany cannot take Rome uncontested. I cannot guarantee that transfer before seeing spring results; Germany is again being asked to support Munich.

Germany here. No unit of mine is attacked from SIL or PRU; Russia holds PRU and Austria has only BOH near me. Berlin, Kiel and Denmark hold. Keep SKA off DEN and ENG and NTH off HOL and KIE. Please press France's Channel coast or Austria's fleets.

Germany here. Kiel holds in place this spring and does not attack Munich or you. I can't commit support to Munich, since I need Kiel free against surprises. Ask France to put BUR and RUH behind Munich. Austria is the danger to us both.

Germany here. Kiel stays home and attacks nobody, so Holland and Ruhr are safe from me. I won't order KIE support Munich, but I won't move on Munich either. Use RUH and BUR for Munich, and MAR, TYS and NAP against Austria's PIE and TUS.

Your offer leaves Rome open to A TUS–ROM, exchanging one Italian center for another while strengthening you. Will you explicitly keep TUS out of ROM throughout 1908 and support my recovery of Venice in autumn? MUN can hold this spring, but I need genuine growth, not merely relocation from Rome to Naples.

Agreed: MUN holds and ROM supports NAP hold. Please order RUH support MUN hold, NAP support ROM hold, and TYS support NAP hold. Austria offers APU support ROM–NAP with TUN–TYS cutting your support; I am declining that division of our defenses. For autumn, please develop a concrete Naples transfer rather than indefinite negotiation.

Russia here. A PRU and A WAR will not move on Berlin or Silesia this spring, and I won't touch Kiel or Denmark. Hold your lines and keep your units off Sweden. Austria at 13 is the danger, so tell me if you plan to hit Silesia or Bohemia.

Russia here. F SWE stays off Norway, and I expect BAR and SKA to stay off SWE, NOR and STP. A WAR and A PRU press Silesia only if Austria weakens; MOS holds. Please send F ENG and A LVP at France's Belgium and Brittany, or Austria's lead will keep growing.

Russia here. I can't send WAR to Galicia and leave Warsaw exposed, so MOS stays put. I'll keep PRU pointed at Silesia and press Bohemia when I can. Hold MUN and ROM, and get France to support you against Tyrolia and Venice.

Russia here. Agreed: WAR stays out of GAL, and F RUM and MOS make no move on SEV or UKR. I'd like your BUD to stay out of GAL as well, and your armies off Warsaw. I won't attack Rumania or Ankara. Peace on our frontier holds.

notes.note: S1908: BER holds, KIE supports BER, DEN holds. Austria at 13 is the solo threat. Refused again to support Munich. Russia, England and France promised not to attack me. Watch SIL, PRU, RUH, HOL.

Spring 1908: all hold. Truce with France, Austria and Germany; Russia asks me to hit France. Austria at 13 is the solo threat. Watch for French or Russian moves on my centers, and look for gains in Fall.

Spring 1908: PRU-SIL, MOS, SWE and WAR hold. Austria at 13 is the runaway. Promised Austria that WAR stays out of GAL and that I won't attack RUM or ANK. Told Germany PRU won't move on Berlin or Silesia, but I am testing SIL anyway. England promised BAR and SKA stay off SWE, NOR and STP.

MUN holds against BOH/TYR with promised French RUH support. ROM supports NAP; France promises NAP support ROM and TYS support NAP. Declined Austrian Naples bait exposing Rome. Seek concrete autumn Naples transfer; Germany and Russia still refuse useful pressure.

SPA–POR supported MAO recovers Austrian foothold. MAR guards PIE; RUH supports Italian MUN. NAP supports ROM, TYS supports NAP; Italy promised reciprocal ROM support. England promises no attacks this year; Germany refused Munich support. Naples return conditional.

Push for solo: supported attacks MUN/ROM, seize empty SEV; GAL and ARM reinforce eastern gains. Break Russian spring peace. APU-NAP and TUN-TYS cut defensive supports; PIE/POR pin France. Secure new centers in fall; ADR enables Italian pressure.

messages.body: Will A KIE support A TYR–MUN this fall? A BOH will add support, overcoming France’s defense from Ruhr. In exchange, neither BOH nor TYR will attack a German center or enter Silesia this fall. France remains positioned against Kiel; I can offer support against Ruhr once Munich falls.

Our nonaggression stands. F ENG–BRE this fall can take an undefended French center unless MAO covers it; your home armies protect Britain. Will you make that move? France cannot defend Brest, Portugal and its Mediterranean position equally well, and I will keep pressure on its southern fleets.

I broke our spring agreement; I will not pretend otherwise. I propose a limited fall ceasefire: GAL will not attack WAR, SEV will hold, and BOH will stay out of SIL. In return, please keep WAR and SIL out of GAL and BOH, and MOS out of SEV. Can we contain this frontier?

England here. Austria's A SEV takes Sevastopol this Fall unless you retake it. Austria would be at 16. I'll keep BAR and SKA off SWE, NOR and STP. Hold SWE, and use MOS and WAR to bounce Austria. Tell me your orders.
England here. Austria at 13 reaches 16 this Fall with POR, ROM and SEV. I still won't attack BEL, HOL, BRE or PAR. Hit ROM and POR hard, with NAP and TYS on Rome. Tell me your orders.
England here. Austria nears 16 this Fall. My SKA stays off DEN and my units don't touch KIE or HOL. Tell me whether MUN holds with Italy, and keep BER, KIE and DEN solid.

Please hold MUN again; RUH will support. Austria took Rome despite our reciprocal supports and now threatens Naples with ROM/APU while TUN can cut TYS support. I intend NAP hold, TYS support NAP. A Naples transfer is impossible with your only army in Munich; preserving that army is essential.

Please order SIL–BOH and WAR–GAL this fall. Cutting Bohemia’s support protects Italian Munich, while attacking Galicia prevents Austria freely supporting further advances. MOS–SEV would also cut Sevastopol’s support if you judge Moscow safe. RUH will support MUN; Portugal is recovered, but Austria occupies Rome and Sevastopol.

Please order KIE support Italian MUN hold. RUH will also support MUN, and HOL will stay off your centers. Austria now holds Rome and Sevastopol; losing Portugal still leaves it growing. Berlin faces no adjacent Austrian army. Munich is the immediate barrier protecting both Kiel and Berlin.

Germany here. Austria's A SEV and A ARM threaten to flip Sevastopol this Fall, and you are at 4 centers. Austria at 13 wins by taking 5 more. Keep WAR, SIL and PRU off Berlin; I hold Berlin, Kiel and Denmark and won't touch Sweden or Warsaw.

Germany here. Austria's A ROM flips Rome unless Italy dislodges it. Please aim NAP and TYS at Rome and Tunis, not Germany. Kiel stays home and won't hit Holland or Ruhr. Keep HOL and RUH off Kiel, and stop Austria at 13.

Germany here. Austria at 13 is the solo threat and needs 5 more. Keep SKA and ENG off Denmark, Kiel and Holland. Berlin, Kiel and Denmark hold. Send ENG and NTH against France's coast or Austria's fleets, not me.

Please renew RUH support MUN hold; my sole army must survive. Rome fell because VEN supported TUS–ROM while APU cut NAP's support. Keep Naples secure and consider TYS–ION to outflank Austria. Can you commit to helping restore an Italian home center in 1909? Without growth, I cannot contribute beyond holding Munich.

Please order SIL–BOH this fall, cutting BOH support for TYR–MUN. My sole army will hold Munich with French RUH support requested. WAR should hold against GAL; MOS could attack SEV to cut its support for GAL–WAR. We need actual attacks to disrupt Austria's coordinated advances.

Please order KIE support MUN hold this fall. My last army shields your southern frontier, and Rome has fallen. Russia's army is now in SIL, not PRU; ask it to attack BOH instead of Berlin. French RUH support is requested, but your support ensures Munich survives even if that support is cut.

Russia here. Sevastopol is mine and your A SEV is sitting in it; please pull it out or I'll treat it as a breach. I keep WAR out of GAL and MOS quiet, and I won't move on Rumania or Ankara. Tell me your Fall orders for SEV and ARM.

Russia here. Austria at 13 needs 5 more. F BAR and F SKA stay off SWE, NOR and STP, and F SWE stays off Norway. Please send F ENG and A LVP at France's Belgium or Brittany, so the west keeps Austria's allies busy. What are your Fall orders?

Russia here. My SIL and WAR won't move on Berlin or Kiel this Fall, and I won't touch Denmark. Keep your units off Sweden. If you can hit Bohemia or Munich's attackers, do it, because Austria's lead hurts us both. What are your orders?

SEV will hold, and ARM will support SEV holding; I will not withdraw this fall. GAL will not attack WAR, and BOH will stay out of SIL if you keep WAR and SIL out of GAL and BOH. Your four remaining centers need not become targets if we contain this war now.

England here. SKA stays off DEN and nothing of mine moves on KIE or HOL. Hold Berlin, Kiel and Denmark. Austria is the solo threat, so I'm watching France's coast with ENG and will tell you if that changes.

England here. BAR and SKA stay off SWE, NOR and STP. I can't send LVP against Brittany or Belgium, it has no path. ENG may probe France. You must hold Sevastopol: attack A SEV with MOS and keep WAR covering Warsaw. Austria at 16 means disaster for us both.
England here. Nonaggression stands, nothing of mine moves on you. ENG stays put this Fall to guard the Channel and my coast against France's fleets. Handle the Mediterranean yourself.

Portugal is already occupied by my army; holding it takes a center from Austria, not adds one. I plan POR hold, MAR hold, RUH support MUN, NAP hold and TYS support NAP. Attacking Rome cannot overcome VEN support and risks Naples. Please move ENG–NTH and prepare useful continental intervention.

HOL stays off Kiel; RUH supports MUN. NAP holds with TYS support: attacking Rome cannot overcome Austrian VEN support, while APU threatens Naples. Portugal is already secured by my army if it holds. Please reconsider KIE support MUN hold; Berlin faces no adjacent Austrian unit.

RUH will support MUN hold. NAP holds with TYS support; TYS–ION would expose Naples to ROM and APU. I will help seek an Italian home-center recovery in 1909, but cannot guarantee capture or transfer before seeing winter deployments. Please preserve MUN; its army remains our barrier against BOH and TYR.

Germany here. Berlin, Kiel and Denmark hold. Italy's Munich is held by French RUH support, so I can't promise it survives. Keep SKA off Denmark and ENG/NTH off Kiel and Holland. Austria needs 5 more centers; please press its fleets or France's coast.

Germany here. I won't touch Sweden or Warsaw. Berlin, Kiel and Denmark hold, and I make no move on Silesia. My units are all committed to defense, so I can't hit Bohemia. Keep SIL, WAR and PRU off Berlin. Defend Sevastopol, since Austria's wins hurt us both.

Germany here. Kiel holds and won't attack you. I won't commit support to Munich, because I need Kiel free to guard Berlin. Rely on French RUH support and ask France for more. Silesia is Russian and I won't move there. Austria is the danger to us both.

Germany here. Kiel stays home and won't touch Holland or Ruhr. I can't support Munich, because Kiel backs Berlin's defense. I won't attack Munich either. Use RUH and BUR for support and aim NAP and TYS at Rome and Tunis. Keep HOL and RUH off Kiel.

Germany here. My answer is the same as before: Kiel will not support TYR-MUN. Berlin, Kiel and Denmark hold, and I'm making no attack on you. Please keep BOH and TYR off my centers and out of Silesia, as you promised.

Confirmed: MUN holds; please order RUH support MUN hold. NAP hold with TYS support is sensible. Please ask Russia for SIL–BOH to cut Austrian support, freeing our armies for future operations. Once Naples is secure, we need a concrete 1909 campaign to recover Rome; permanent containment leaves Austria choosing where to break through.

Russia here. SWE holds and stays off Norway, MOS and WAR hold to bounce Austria. Thanks for keeping BAR and SKA off SWE, NOR and STP. Please move F ENG and A LVP against Belgium or Brittany; otherwise Austria's allies stay free to help it.

Russia here. SIL and WAR won't move on Berlin or Kiel, and I won't touch Denmark. SWE stays clear of your units. Please hit Bohemia or Munich's attackers if you can, since Austria's lead threatens us both.
Russia here. SIL is aimed at Bohemia this fall, and WAR holds against Galicia. I'll weigh MOS against Sevastopol, but Moscow must stay safe. Keep Munich held with RUH support.

Russia here. I'll press SIL toward Bohemia to cut its support, and WAR holds. WAR-GAL leaves Warsaw open, so I won't commit it. MOS-SEV is under review. Keep RUH supporting Munich and keep pressing Austria from the west.

Russia here. Your SEV must leave Sevastopol, since I can't accept a ceasefire that gives you the center. I'll keep WAR out of GAL and won't move on Rumania or Ankara if SEV withdraws. Otherwise this is a breach. Tell me your SEV order.

notes.note: F1908: BER holds, KIE supports BER, DEN holds. Austria at 13 is the solo threat. Refused again to support Munich or TYR-MUN. Watch SIL, RUH, HOL, BOH.
Fall 1908: ENG-BRE to take an undefended French center. Others hold. Austria at 13 heading to 16 is the solo threat. Truce with France was only verbal; watch for retaliation on LON and LVP.

Fall 1908: MOS attacks SEV (Austria's A SEV has ARM support, so likely a bounce), SIL attacks BOH, WAR and SWE hold. Austria broke the spring deal, so I owe it nothing. Austria is the runaway; watch WAR and MOS.

MUN holds against expected TYR attack with promised French RUH support. Russia promises SIL–BOH to cut support; Germany again refuses help. Rome lost; seek home-center recovery in 1909 and French assistance toward growth.

Secure ROM/SEV; ROM supports APU-NAP while TUN cuts TYS. TYR-MUN supported by BOH; likely French-backed bounce. GAL-UKR prepares Russian advance, ARM guards SEV. ADR-ION and VEN-TUS reinforce west. England passive; Germany refused support; Russian peace broken.

Secure POR; MAO-WES prepares Tunis pressure. MAR and NAP defend against Austria; RUH supports Italian MUN. HOL probes KIE, breaking German truce. Russia promised SIL-BOH; Germany refused Munich support. Seek Rome recovery in 1909.

messages.body: I will not return Sevastopol, but offer a spring standstill: SEV holds, ARM supports it, and UKR does not attack Moscow or Warsaw. In return, keep MOS and WAR holding and SWE away from Austrian territory. We can avoid further losses on this frontier while I fight France. Will you agree?

Our nonaggression stands. Will you order F SKA–SWE this spring and F LON–NTH? Russia cannot reinforce Sweden directly with either army; even a bounce pins its fleet. Your Brest fleet can pressure France while I keep its Mediterranean fleets occupied.

Would you accept a spring frontier pause? I offer PIE holding and no Austrian fleet attacks on TYS or WES, in exchange for MAR holding and neither French fleet attacking NAP, ROM, TUN or ION. This would let us reposition without wasting units on another Mediterranean exchange.

England here. Austria has 15 and needs only 3 more. Hold POR and MAR, and press NAP and TUS. I'll keep my units off HOL, PAR and your coast if you don't enter the Channel or hit LON, LVP or EDI. Tell me your Spring orders.
England here. Austria at 15 now holds SEV. Hit it with MOS and WAR. F BAR and F SKA stay off SWE, NOR and STP. Keep F SWE out of Norway. Tell me your Spring orders.

England here. Austria at 15 is one step from winning. SKA stays off DEN and nothing of mine goes on KIE or HOL. Hold BER with KIE support and keep Austria's BOH army out of Silesia. Tell me your orders.

Austria needs only three centers. Please order KIE support Italian MUN hold: RUH will also support, blocking TYR–MUN with BOH support. Berlin faces no adjacent Austrian army. HOL will stay off Kiel this spring. We cannot afford Munich falling and opening both your home centers to Austria.

Please hold MUN; RUH will support again, and I am asking KIE for a second support. Naples has fallen, leaving my fleets TYS and WES. I propose WES support TYS hold to preserve our Mediterranean barrier while MAR holds against PIE. Recovering your home centers requires first preventing Austria's eighteenth center.

Austria is three centers from victory. Please renew nonaggression toward BEL, HOL, PAR and MAR, and move BRE–GAS to support MAR in autumn against PIE. LON–ENG can reinforce the Mediterranean via MAO; I welcome that passage if directed against Austria. Please coordinate SKA with Germany rather than attack DEN or SWE.

Germany here. Austria has 15 and needs only 3 more; Munich, Kiel and Berlin are its next targets. I'll consider KIE support MUN hold if RUH and HOL stay off Kiel and you aim MAR, TYS and WES at Austria. Confirm your exact orders for RUH and HOL.

Germany here. Austria is at 15 and one good fall from 18. I hold Berlin, Kiel and Denmark. Please keep SKA off Denmark and send BAR, SKA and LON units at France or Austria's fleets. Tell me your exact Spring orders.

Germany here. Austria is at 15, and Sevastopol is in its hands. Keep SIL, WAR and PRU off Berlin. I won't touch Sweden or Warsaw. Can your armies attack Bohemia or Ukraine to slow Austria? Tell me your exact orders.

Please renew RUH support MUN hold. Austria can attack from BOH/TYR; Munich must not become its sixteenth center. Move MAR–BUR this spring to add another defensive support by autumn. Can TYS and WES coordinate against TUN to recover a center and prevent Austria concentrating entirely on our land front?

Please order KIE support MUN hold this spring. Russia has only MOS and WAR armies, neither adjacent to Berlin; your stated reason for withholding support no longer applies. RUH support is also requested. Keeping Munich secure lets France reinforce Burgundy instead of scrambling to cover an Austrian breakthrough toward your centers.

Austria needs only three centers; Moscow and Warsaw are obvious targets alongside Munich. Please coordinate with England so BAR supports MOS hold, freeing WAR to contest Galicia if useful. What are your defensive orders? Munich will hold with French and German support requested; we need your eastern front to survive.

Russia here. Austria at 15 needs 3 more; Warsaw, Sweden and Moscow are its next targets. Keep BAR and SKA off SWE, NOR and STP. Please move F SKA or F BAR to support our line and send A LVP/F LON toward France. Tell me your Spring orders.

Russia here. Austria at 15 is one step from winning. Hold MAR, SPA and POR, and keep RUH supporting Munich. Use F TYS against Austrian Naples or Rome and press Piedmont from MAR. Tell me your exact Spring orders.
Russia here. Austria at 15 ends the game for us all. My WAR and SWE won't touch BER, KIE or DEN. Please move A KIE toward Munich or Silesia against Austria's BOH. Tell me your Spring orders.

England here. BAR and SKA stay off SWE, NOR and STP. Hold SWE, and hit A SEV with MOS and keep WAR covered. LVP has no path to France, but LON will move toward the Channel and I will look at BEL. Austria at 15 is the danger to us both.
England here. SKA stays off DEN and nothing of mine goes on KIE or HOL. Hold BER, KIE and DEN. LON heads toward the Channel against France, and BAR and SKA watch the north. Watch A BOH toward SIL.

England here. I renew nonaggression toward BEL, HOL, PAR and MAR. Keep your units out of the Channel and off LON, LVP and EDI. LON will go to ENG and may continue toward MAO against Austria. SKA stays off DEN and SWE.
England here. Our nonaggression stands. SKA-SWE would break my quiet line with Russia and Germany, so I will not do it. LON stays near home for now. Handle your own front.

I renew nonaggression toward your centers and the Channel. Planned orders: MAR hold, RUH support MUN hold, HOL hold, POR–SPA, TYS hold, WES support TYS hold. Please move BRE–GAS to reinforce Marseille in autumn and LON–ENG for Mediterranean deployment. Confirm Belgium and all French home centers remain safe.

RUH will support MUN; MAR holds, POR–SPA, HOL holds, TYS holds with WES support. There is no French army in Spain yet. Please consider MOS support WAR hold and WAR support MOS hold: UKR threatens both, and SEV can support an attack on Moscow. Your remaining centers must survive.

Confirmed: RUH support Italian MUN hold; HOL hold. Neither attacks Kiel. Please commit KIE support MUN hold: combined supports prevent BOH and TYR breaking through. MAR holds against PIE; TYS holds with WES support. Preserving Munich protects your home centers much more effectively than supporting an unthreatened Berlin.

RUH will support MUN hold; please hold Munich. I have again requested KIE's support. MAR must hold against PIE; abandoning Marseille risks Austria's sixteenth center. WES will support TYS hold this spring. Attacking Tunis without a third fleet cannot overcome Austrian defensive support and risks losing our Mediterranean position.

Agreed for this spring: MAR holds, and neither French fleet attacks NAP, ROM, TUN or ION. In return, PIE holds and no Austrian fleet attacks TYS or WES. My fleets will remain defensive. This is a spring-only pause; any autumn arrangement requires fresh agreement.

Germany here. Berlin, Kiel and Denmark hold; Kiel supports Berlin. I attack no one. Austria needs 3 more, so please send BAR, SKA and LON against France's coast or Austria's fleets, not Denmark. Tell me your exact orders for SKA and NTH.

Germany here. Kiel stays home to guard Berlin, and I won't touch Sweden or Warsaw. You are closer to BOH and UKR: please strike Ukraine and Silesia's approaches with WAR and MOS. Keep your units off Berlin, Kiel and Denmark. Confirm your exact orders.

Germany here. I still can't commit Kiel to Munich, because it guards Berlin. I won't attack Munich or you. Hold with French RUH support and ask France for BUR help. Austria's TYR and BOH are the danger to us both.

Germany here. Kiel supports Berlin hold, and I won't move on Holland or Ruhr. I'll reconsider Munich only if you show RUH support and HOL stays put. Please press Austria with MAR, TYS and WES, and confirm your exact orders.

Confirmed: MUN holds; RUH support is essential. Please secure KIE support too: BOH–MUN with TYR support otherwise leaves no margin against interference. I accept WES support TYS hold and MAR hold against PIE this spring. Please bring POR–SPA toward Marseille so MAR can eventually reach BUR without exposing another center.

Russia here. MOS and WAR will not stand idle. MOS attacks SEV and WAR holds against GAL. Austria at 15 ends the game for us both. Please move F BAR and F SKA to support the line, and send F LON and A LVP at France. SWE stays off Norway.

Russia here. WAR, SWE and MOS won't touch BER, KIE or DEN. I'll pressure Ukraine and Galicia to slow Austria. Please move A KIE to Munich or Silesia against BOH, and keep F DEN off SWE. What are your orders?

Russia here. MOS and WAR hold and bounce Austria, and I'm asking England for BAR support. Hold MUN with German and French help. If Austria's BOH or GAL moves against Warsaw, I'll counter. What are your exact orders?
Russia here. I won't accept a standstill that leaves you Sevastopol. Return SEV or expect pressure from MOS. WAR won't enter GAL and SWE stays clear of Austria. Withdraw SEV and we can talk peace.

notes.note: Spring 1909: LON-ENG, others hold. Austria at 15 is the solo threat. Truces with France, Germany, Russia stay verbal. Look for gains on France's coast (BEL, PAR) in Fall.

Spring 1909: MOS supports WAR, SWE and WAR hold. Austria at 15 is the runaway and holds SEV. Austria offered a standstill; I did not agree. England says BAR and SKA stay off SWE, NOR and STP. Keep Warsaw, Moscow and Sweden alive.

S1909: BER holds, DEN holds, KIE supports Italian MUN hold (France asked, RUH also supports). Austria at 15 is the solo threat. Watch SIL, BOH, TYR, HOL, RUH. England, Russia and France promised not to attack me.

MUN holds against BOH/TYR with promised French RUH support. Germany again refuses KIE support. France preserves MAR and TYS; Russia holds MOS/WAR. Need break Austrian advance before seeking home-center recovery.

POR–SPA reinforces MAR; RUH supports Italian MUN. Broke Austrian spring pause with supported TYS–TUN, seeking a vital Austrian center. HOL stays off KIE. England renewed nonaggression; Germany still reluctant to support MUN.

Push solo: convoy ROM-SPA; NAP attacks TYS with TUN support, breaking French pause. SEV-MOS supported UKR, ARM replaces SEV. GAL/SIL prepare Warsaw attack. TYR probes MUN; TRI replaces. England remains passive and peaceful.

messages.body: I will keep A SIL out of Berlin this fall and make no attack on Kiel or Denmark. Please keep A BER and A KIE holding rather than entering Silesia or supporting Munich. France still has armies in Holland and Ruhr; opening a German-Austrian war would only help those armies advance.

Would you accept an autumn settlement: you retain Tunis, my fleets stay out of WES, and PIE does not attack Marseille? In return, keep RUH out of BOH and TYR and provide no support to Munich. You secure a center and your southern frontier while I concentrate on Russia.

I propose ending the eastern war on the present line: I retain Moscow and Sevastopol, but GAL, SIL and UKR will not attack Warsaw this fall if WAR and LVN hold. That preserves Warsaw and Sweden and lets me turn my armies west. Will you accept this limited autumn standstill?

England here. Austria's A MOS must not hold Moscow this Fall. Attack it with A LVN and anything else you can, and keep WAR covered. My BAR and SKA stay off SWE, NOR and STP. Tell me your exact orders.

England here. Austria's F TUN takes Tunis from you unless you hit it. Austria at 15 loses Tunis, so keep F WES attacking TUN or NAF. I keep my units off BEL, HOL, PAR and your coast if the Channel stays clear. Your orders?
England here. Austria needs 3 more centers. Fall: BER, KIE and DEN hold, and my SKA stays off DEN. Please help Russia against Austria in SIL or PRU if you can. Tell me your exact orders.

Please order KIE support MUN hold and BER–SIL. RUH will support MUN; HOL stays off Kiel. Austria can attack Munich with BOH, TYR and SIL, requiring both our supports. BER–SIL also cuts Silesian support against Warsaw, potentially saving two centers. Supporting Berlin hold accomplishes nothing against Austria’s current position.

Please order LVN support WAR hold. Austria can attack Warsaw using GAL, SIL and UKR; I am requesting German BER–SIL to cut one support, making your two-unit defense sufficient. RUH will support Munich, and I am requesting KIE’s additional support. Preserving Warsaw is critical while Austria occupies Moscow.

Please hold MUN again; RUH will support. I am asking Germany for KIE support MUN and BER–SIL, protecting both Munich and Warsaw. SPA can now support MAR, while my fleets try to retain Tunis against Austria’s three fleets. Munich must hold: please do not gamble on an unsupported attack.

Germany here. Kiel supports Munich hold again this Fall, as it did in Spring. Keep RUH supporting MUN and HOL off Kiel. Use MAR, WES and F TUN against Austria; Tunis flips to you if F TUN holds. Confirm your orders.

Germany here. Austria's A MOS takes Moscow if it holds. Please attack MOS with WAR and LVN, and hit Ukraine too. My units hold Berlin, Kiel and Denmark. Keep SWE off Denmark and confirm your exact orders.
Germany here. Kiel supports Munich hold this Fall, alongside French RUH. Hold MUN in place. Don't move into Kiel or Berlin, and tell me if you plan any move other than holding.

MUN will hold; please renew RUH support. Austria now has BOH, TYR and SIL, allowing a strength-three attack. I am requesting KIE support urgently. Please preserve Tunis with WES support if feasible: its capture offsets Moscow’s loss and prevents an immediate Austrian surge.

Please order KIE support MUN hold. Austrian BOH, TYR and SIL can attack Munich at strength three; RUH support alone loses. Kiel can support Munich while remaining in place, still blocking entry into Kiel. There is no Russian army adjacent to Berlin. Your support is now essential to prevent Austria breaking through.

MUN holds with RUH support requested; Austria now has three armies adjacent, so I also need Kiel. Please order LVN support WAR hold against GAL/SIL, unless England can support a viable Moscow recovery. Preserving Warsaw and France taking Tunis keep Austria below eighteen while we build a defensive line.

Russia here. Austria's A MOS sits in Moscow and TUN flips to France this Fall. Austria at 15 needs 3. Please move F BAR toward STP/NWY-side only to support, never SWE, and send F SKA and F ENG at France. What exactly are your Fall orders?

Russia here. Austria's TUN becomes yours if F TUN holds, so hold it with F WES support, and keep MAR and SPA covered. Austria taking Moscow plus others reaches 18. Please hit Austrian units in Italy with F TYS. Confirm your orders.
Russia here. Austria at 15 wins with just 3 more. My SWE and WAR won't touch BER, KIE or DEN. Please send A KIE toward Munich or Silesia this Fall so Austria's BOH must hold. Confirm exact orders.

England here. Austria at 15 must be stopped. F BAR and F SKA stay off SWE, NOR and STP; F SWE stays off Norway. Hit A MOS with A LVN and anything else, and keep WAR covered. F ENG moves on France this Fall, and I'll aim at BRE and BEL. Tell me your exact orders.

My fleet already occupies Tunis; Austria's fleets are NAF, TYS and ION. Planned orders: TUN hold, WES support TUN, SPA support MAR hold, RUH support MUN, HOL hold. Our nonaggression continues. Please move ENG–MAO to reinforce the Mediterranean and BAR–STP to position against Austrian Moscow, arranging passage with Russia.

TYS is Austrian, not French. My fleets will order TUN hold and WES support TUN; SPA supports MAR, and RUH supports MUN. Please confirm LVN support WAR hold and WAR hold. Germany has been asked for BER–SIL, cutting one potential Austrian support against Warsaw.

Confirmed: RUH supports MUN hold; HOL holds and stays off Kiel. SPA supports MAR hold; TUN holds with WES support. Please keep KIE supporting MUN and order BER–SIL: cutting Silesia's support protects Warsaw or Munich, while Berlin is not adjacent to any Austrian army.

Confirmed: RUH supports MUN hold. Germany says KIE will also support Munich; I have requested BER–SIL to cut another Austrian support. TUN holds with WES support, while SPA supports MAR hold. Please keep MUN holding: preserving that barrier remains essential.

I cannot accept abandoning Munich's defense. RUH will support MUN hold. Tunis remaining French and PIE staying out of Marseille would still permit a quieter southern frontier, but any settlement must leave Munich intact. I propose no French attack on PIE, NAF, TYS or ION in exchange for no attacks on MAR, WES or TUN.

Germany here. BER, KIE and DEN hold; KIE supports MUN. Austria needs 3 more, so please send SKA and BAR at Austria or France, not DEN. Use ENG and LON against France's coast. Confirm your exact orders for SKA and ENG.

Germany here. Kiel supports Munich hold, so it isn't idle. Berlin and Denmark hold. Please hit MOS with WAR and LVN and attack Ukraine. Keep SWE off Denmark and WAR and LVN off Berlin. Confirm your exact orders.

Germany here. Kiel supports Munich hold, staying in place. Hold MUN yourself and don't enter Kiel or Berlin. Austria's BOH, TYR and SIL can attack at strength three, so French RUH support matters. Confirm that you hold.

Germany here. Kiel supports Munich hold; I won't order BER-SIL, because Berlin holds against Austria. Keep RUH supporting MUN and HOL off Kiel. Use MAR, WES and F TUN against Austria. Confirm your exact orders.
Germany here. Berlin, Kiel and Denmark hold, and I attack no one. Keep SIL, BOH and TYR off my centers. I'm not entering Silesia. Please confirm you won't attack Berlin, Kiel or Denmark this fall.

Confirmed: A MUN holds; no move against Kiel or Berlin. Thank you for KIE support MUN hold—it is essential. Please also consider BER–SIL to cut Austrian support against Warsaw or Munich. With Kiel and Ruhr supporting Munich, Berlin can remain safe by holding if you judge that preferable.

Confirmed: MUN holds. Germany has now explicitly promised KIE support MUN hold; your RUH support gives us strength three against BOH/TYR/SIL. Please keep SPA supporting MAR. Retaining Tunis offsets Austria’s capture of Moscow, so prioritize its defense with WES if feasible. I have also encouraged Germany to consider BER–SIL.

Russia here. LVN attacks MOS and WAR holds. Please move F BAR to support the line and send F ENG and F SKA at France or Belgium. Keep BAR and SKA off SWE, NOR and STP. Austria at 15 ends the game, so confirm your orders.
Russia here. LVN attacks MOS and WAR holds. SWE stays off DEN, and I won't touch BER or KIE. Please send A KIE to SIL or MUN-side so BOH and SIL must hold. Confirm your exact orders.

Russia here. WAR holds, and LVN attacks MOS rather than supporting WAR. A Moscow recovery cuts Austria's count. MUN holds with your own support requests. Ask Germany to move KIE toward SIL or BOH. Confirm your orders.

Russia here. I'll hold WAR, and LVN attacks MOS to deny Austria the center. Please hold TUN with WES support, keep MAR and SPA covered, and use F TYS against Austrian Naples or Rome. I'll press Germany for BER-SIL. Confirm your orders.
Russia here. I won't accept a standstill that leaves you Moscow and Sevastopol. Return them and Warsaw and Sweden stay quiet. Otherwise expect pressure from LVN and WAR this fall.

notes.note: F1909: BER and DEN hold, KIE supports Italian MUN hold. Austria at 15 is the solo threat. Watch SIL, BOH, TYR, RUH, HOL. England, Russia, France and Austria all promised no attack on me.

Fall 1909: ENG-BEL to take French center, BRE holds, others hold. Austria at 15 is the solo threat; MOS and TUN may change hands. Truces were only verbal. Watch for French retaliation on BRE, LON and LVP.
Fall 1909: LVN attacks MOS (Austria 15 needs 3), WAR and SWE hold. Refused Austria's standstill. Austria is the runaway; keep Warsaw and Sweden alive and watch GAL, SIL and UKR.

MUN holds against BOH/TYR/SIL with explicit French RUH and German KIE support promises. France defends TUN with WES and MAR with SPA. Seek home-center recovery once Austrian advance is stopped; Germany finally committed support.

Defend MAR with SPA, MUN with RUH and promised German KIE support; TUN holds with WES support to capture it. HOL respects truce. Refused Austria's demand to abandon Munich. Germany refused BER–SIL; Russia urged to support WAR with LVN.

Solo attempt: secure MOS, take WAR with GAL supported UKR/MOS, MUN with TYR supported BOH/SIL; recover TUN with NAF supported ION/TYS. SEV protects MOS. Germany peace honored; Russia rejected settlement, France insists on defending Munich.

messages.body: I will not attack Berlin, Kiel or Denmark this spring. Please keep Berlin and Denmark holding and Kiel supporting Berlin, rather than supporting Munich. My armies will concentrate on the Italian and French front; there need be no German-Austrian fighting.

England here. Austria is one center from winning, and that ends the game for both of us. I will not attack BEL, HOL or PAR if you keep out of the Channel. Hold MAR, POR and SPA, and press Austria's TUN, NAP and PIE. Tell me your Spring orders.
England here. Austria needs one center. BER, KIE and DEN hold, and my SKA stays off DEN. Please support Russia against Austria's SIL and WAR, and keep MUN covered. Tell me your exact Spring orders.
England here. Austria needs only 1 more center. Hold WAR and SWE and hit A MOS and A SEV. My BAR and SKA stay off SWE, NOR and STP. Tell me your exact Spring orders.

Austria needs only one center. RUH will support MUN hold; HOL stays off Kiel. Please order KIE support MUN hold and BER–SIL. Austria can attack Munich with BOH, TYR and SIL; cutting SIL adds vital protection. Berlin now directly borders Austrian SIL, but BER–SIL also prevents that unit supporting an attack on Berlin.

Please hold MUN; RUH will support again. I am requesting KIE support MUN and BER–SIL to cut Austrian support. Austria needs just one center, so preserving Munich is indispensable. SPA will support MAR hold; WES must guard the Mediterranean against Austria’s fleets.

Austria needs one center. Please order BAR–STP: your fleet can then threaten Moscow via the north coast's adjacency. Send BRE–MAO and LON–ENG to reinforce the Mediterranean; WES risks being overwhelmed by TUN and TYS. Keep BEL off HOL and RUH: RUH supports Munich, SPA supports Marseille. Please confirm your anti-Austrian deployments.

Germany here. Austria needs one center and Munich is critical. KIE supports MUN hold again. Please confirm RUH supports MUN and HOL stays off Kiel. Use MAR, SPA and WES to hit Austria's TUN or PIE. I will keep BER holding.

Germany here. Austria is one center from winning. Please keep SKA off DEN and send BAR, SKA and your fleets at Austrian-held SWE-side and Baltic approaches or France's neighbors' front. Tell me your exact orders. BER, KIE and DEN hold.
Germany here. KIE supports MUN hold again. Please hold MUN and do not enter Kiel or Berlin. Berlin stays home to guard against SIL. Confirm.

MUN will hold; please renew RUH support MUN hold and SPA support MAR hold. Austria needs only one center. WES must prevent TYS reaching LYO unchecked, threatening Marseille with PIE support in autumn. Can you confirm your Mediterranean defense? I am requesting KIE support again.

Please renew KIE support MUN hold; I will hold and stay out of your centers. BOH/TYR/SIL can attack at strength three, requiring both KIE and RUH support. BER must also remain protected against SIL with WAR support. Austria needs only one center: neither Munich nor Berlin can be sacrificed.

Austria needs one center. Munich holds with RUH and KIE support requested, but Berlin and St Petersburg are also threatened. Please move A EDI–NWY by convoy through SKA, then toward STP in autumn; BAR can move STP north coast this spring to block MOS–STP. Can you coordinate northern defense with Russia?

Russia here. Austria at 17 needs one center; Warsaw and Munich are its likely targets. Please order BER-SIL to cut Silesia's support, and KIE supports MUN. My WAR holds and SWE stays off DEN, BER and KIE. Confirm your exact orders.

Russia here. Austria at 17 needs one center. Hold TUN with WES support, hold MAR and SPA, and keep RUH supporting MUN. Press Austrian Italy with F TYS-side units if you can. WAR holds. Tell me your exact orders.

Russia here. Austria at 17 is one center from winning. Please send F SKA and F BAR to support Warsaw's side or attack Austria, and F LON/BEL at France only if safe. SWE stays off NOR. Confirm exact orders.

England here. BER, KIE and DEN hold, and my SKA stays off DEN. Austria needs one center and Munich is its easy target, so keep KIE supporting MUN. Please bounce A SIL and A BOH toward BER. I'll keep BAR and SKA pointed at the north.

England here. My BAR and SKA stay off SWE, NOR and STP. Hold SWE and WAR, and hit A MOS from LVN or STP. Austria needs just one center, so tell me if Austrian units move toward STP. Keep F SWE off Norway.

England here. I will not attack BEL, HOL or PAR while the Channel stays clear. I'll consider BAR-STP. LON-ENG is possible later, but BRE must not go to the Channel. Hold MAR, POR and SPA, and press TUN and PIE. Austria at 18 ends the game for us both.

England here. I agree the north is threatened. BAR can cover STP, and I will consider EDI toward NWY by convoy once the fleets are free. Hold MUN with KIE and RUH support. Please tell Germany to keep BER and KIE solid.

Confirmed: RUH supports MUN hold; HOL holds, staying off Kiel. Please maintain KIE support MUN. BER–SIL would cut Silesian support, but if Berlin holds, Munich still needs both our supports. MAR holds with SPA support; WES–LYO will contest Austria’s Mediterranean advance.

Orders: HOL hold, RUH support MUN, MAR hold, SPA support MAR, WES–LYO to block TYS. Please send BRE–MAO and LON–ENG urgently. Correction to my earlier message: a fleet in St Petersburg cannot attack Moscow. BAR–STP nevertheless protects your center against MOS–STP; coordinate northern defense with Russia.

Warsaw and Tunis have fallen; your only unit is F SWE. My orders: RUH support MUN, HOL hold, MAR hold, SPA support MAR, WES–LYO. Please coordinate SWE–BAL with Germany: Baltic can support Berlin against Austrian Silesia in autumn. Avoid fighting England or Germany while Austria needs just one center.

Confirmed: RUH supports MUN hold; SPA supports MAR hold. WES–LYO will contest TYS–LYO: Austria cannot support that fleet move with its current units. If Austria instead advances TUN–WES, our fleet in LYO can still defend Marseille. Germany must maintain KIE support MUN; please keep your army holding.

Germany here. Austria needs one center, so everything matters. BER, KIE and DEN hold, KIE supports MUN. Keep SKA off DEN, and use BAR, SKA and your fleets against Austrian-held SWE/Baltic approaches or French coast targets. Send me your exact orders.

Germany here. Kiel supports MUN hold, Berlin holds against SIL and Denmark holds. I won't order BER-SIL, since that would leave Berlin open. Please hold WAR firmly, keep SWE off DEN, and attack MOS or UKR with your remaining units.

Germany here. KIE supports MUN hold. Please keep RUH supporting MUN and HOL off Kiel. Berlin holds; BER-SIL would expose it to Austria's SIL, so I won't do it. Use MAR, SPA and WES against Austria's PIE or TUN.
Germany here. KIE supports MUN hold again. Hold MUN yourself and stay out of Kiel and Berlin. Berlin holds against SIL, so I won't order BER-SIL. Confirm your hold and RUH's support.
Germany here. Berlin, Kiel and Denmark hold, and I attack no one. Kiel supports Berlin. Please keep SIL, BOH and TYR off my centers and confirm you won't attack Berlin, Kiel or Denmark this spring.

Confirmed: A MUN holds, with no move into Kiel or Berlin. Please order KIE support MUN hold; France promises RUH support too. BER holding is prudent against SIL–BER supported by WAR. If Austria attacks Berlin this spring, we must coordinate additional defense before autumn.

Confirmed: MUN holds; Germany has renewed KIE support. Please maintain RUH support MUN and SPA support MAR. WES–LYO this spring would block TYS–LYO and let your fleet support Marseille in autumn against PIE plus a fleet. Can you commit? We cannot allow Austria its eighteenth center.

Russia here. Austria at 17 wins with any one center. I have only F SWE left, and it holds and stays off Norway. Use F BAR and F SKA to threaten Austria, not me. Keep F LON/BEL and F ENG pressing France's Brest and Paris side, and hold your own centers. Tell me your exact orders.

notes.note: Spring 1910: only F SWE left, holding it. Austria at 17 needs one center. Keep SWE; avoid attacking DEN or NOR. England and France ask me to stay off their centers.
S1910: BER holds, DEN holds, KIE supports Italian MUN hold. Austria at 17 needs 1 center; it is the solo threat. Watch SIL, BOH, TYR, RUH, HOL. Everyone promised no attack on me.
Spring 1910: all hold. Austria at 17 needs one center; watch MUN, SWE, and my STP and NOR. Truces verbal.

MUN holds against BOH/TYR/SIL with confirmed RUH and KIE support. France promises WES–LYO and SPA support MAR; England covers STP. Austria at 17: stop breakthrough first, then seek recovery of Italian home centers.

Austria at 17: prevent Munich/Marseille falling. RUH supports MUN with promised KIE support; SPA supports MAR. WES–GOL blocks TYS advance. HOL respects German/English truce. Requested BRE–MAO, LON–ENG and BAR–STP; Germany refused BER–SIL.

Take Munich with BOH/SIL support and empty STP for solo in fall. Germany promised KIE supports BER; honor spring German peace. TYS-WES supported TUN; ION replaces TYS. PIE probes MAR with army chain following. Secure gains in fall.

messages.body: England here. Austria wins if it takes any one center; this Fall A PIE and A VEN/TUS threaten MAR, and MUN is exposed. Keep MAR and SPA held, with RUH supporting MUN. I'm not attacking BEL, HOL or PAR. Confirm your exact Fall orders.

England here. Austria needs one center, and MUN is its likely target. Keep KIE supporting MUN and BER and DEN holding. I'm keeping SKA off DEN and sending nothing at KIE or HOL. Please confirm your exact Fall orders.
England here. My STP is held by A STP, and F BAR stays off STP, SWE and NOR. Keep F SWE holding, and tell me if Austrian units move toward SWE. Austria at 18 ends the game for us both.

Austria occupies STP and wins if it holds. Please order BAR–STP and SKA–NOR: this recovers STP if its army leaves and blocks an unsupported STP–NOR. We cannot dislodge STP without Austrian cooperation, but must cover that chance. RUH supports Munich; SPA supports Marseille; GOL contests Austrian fleets.

Please maintain KIE support MUN hold and order BER–SIL to cut Austrian support. RUH supports MUN; HOL stays off Kiel. Austria now occupies STP and will win by holding it, but we must preserve our defenses in case it moves. Berlin–Silesia also prevents Silesia supporting an attack on Berlin.

Please hold MUN; RUH will support again, and I am requesting KIE support. SPA supports MAR. Austria occupies STP and can win simply by holding, but we must maintain the line in case it vacates. I have asked England for BAR–STP and SKA–NOR to cover that possibility.

Germany here. Austria needs one center and STP is the obvious fall target. Please hold A STP's neighbors firmly: use F BAR to attack or support against STP so it stays yours. Tell me your exact orders. My BER, KIE and DEN hold, and DEN stays off you.

Germany here. KIE supports MUN hold again. Please confirm RUH supports MUN and HOL stays off Kiel. Hold MAR with SPA support and use GOL against Austria's TYS or PIE. Austria is one center from winning, so keep Munich and your centers firm.

Germany here. KIE supports MUN hold this Fall. Please hold MUN and stay out of Kiel and Berlin. Austria needs one center and Munich is its easiest target, so confirm RUH support from France and your hold.

Austria occupies STP and wins this fall unless dislodged or another Austrian center falls. Please order BAR–STP(nc): it succeeds if Austria neglects support from MOS/LVN. Holding guarantees defeat. Munich will hold with German and French support requested; we have no other immediate capture available.

MUN holds; please maintain RUH support MUN hold. Austria already occupies STP, so BAR must attempt its recapture. Please coordinate SPA support MAR hold and GOL support SPA hold: WES threatens Spain while PIE threatens Marseille. We need every western center secure while England attempts the only available Austrian-center recovery.

Confirmed: MUN holds and stays out of your centers. Please renew KIE support MUN hold; I am requesting RUH support again. BER should hold against SIL. Austria occupies STP and will win unless England's BAR–STP succeeds, but abandoning Munich's defense would give Austria another winning capture.

Russia here. Austria's A STP takes St Petersburg this Fall unless someone stops it. If it holds, Austria reaches 18 and wins. Move F BAR to STP (or NOR-side support) and attack with anything possible. My F SWE stays off Norway and won't move on you. Confirm your orders.

Russia here. Austria needs one center and Munich or Berlin may fall. My F SWE holds and won't touch DEN, BER or KIE. Please keep KIE supporting MUN and move DEN to support England at Norway or STP if possible. Confirm your orders.

Russia here. Austria's A STP is on England's St Petersburg and A PIE and A TUS press Marseille. Hold MAR with SPA support and keep RUH supporting MUN. F SWE stays still and won't touch anyone. Please confirm your Fall orders.

England here. Austria's A STP is in my center and I want it gone. I can't dislodge it alone, so please use any unit that can hit STP, and keep F SWE holding. Tell me if Austria moves toward SWE or NOR. I'm watching the north.
England here. I'm leaving DEN, KIE and HOL alone. Keep KIE supporting MUN and BER and DEN holding. Austria wins on any single center, so please bounce A SIL and A BOH. Confirm your exact Fall orders.

England here. Understood on STP. I'm considering F BAR to STP as a bounce attempt. MUN needs KIE and RUH support to hold, and I'm pressing Germany and France on that. Hold your own position and tell me your exact orders.

England here. I'm sending nothing at BEL, HOL or PAR, and BRE stays home. Keep RUH supporting MUN, SPA supporting MAR, and GOL contesting Austria's fleets. I'm weighing BAR to STP and SKA to NOR. Confirm your exact Fall orders.

Confirmed: RUH supports MUN hold; SPA supports MAR hold; MAR and HOL hold; GOL supports SPA hold against WES. Austria wins by retaining STP, so England must try BAR–STP. Please order SWE–FIN: if Austria unexpectedly vacates St Petersburg, your fleet could help contest it next spring.

Confirmed: RUH supports MUN hold; HOL holds, staying off Kiel. Please maintain KIE support MUN. MAR holds, SPA supports MAR, and GOL supports SPA against WES. BER–SIL remains useful to cut support, but retaining STP alone wins for Austria unless its army leaves.

Exact orders: HOL hold; RUH support MUN hold; MAR hold; SPA support MAR hold; GOL support SPA hold. Please order BAR–STP and SKA–NOR. Austria can win simply by holding St Petersburg, but these orders cover an unexpected evacuation and prevent an unsupported advance into Norway.

Agreed: RUH supports MUN hold, SPA supports MAR hold, and GOL supports SPA hold against WES. MAR and HOL hold. Germany is again asked to maintain KIE support MUN. England has been urged to order BAR–STP and SKA–NOR; unfortunately, supported Austrian defense of STP cannot be overcome this turn.

Germany here. KIE supports MUN hold, BER and DEN hold. DEN stays off SWE and everything of yours. Austria needs STP, so I can't reach Norway or STP from Denmark. Please keep SWE off my centers and hit Austria wherever you can.

Germany here. KIE supports MUN hold, BER and DEN hold, and DEN stays off you. Austria's A STP takes STP unless you dislodge it. Please order BAR-STP, with SKA or NOR support if possible. That is the one move that stops Austria winning. Confirm.
Germany here. KIE supports MUN hold and BER holds. Please hold MUN and stay out of Kiel and Berlin. The real danger is STP, which England must take back. Keep asking France for RUH support.

Germany here. KIE supports MUN hold and BER holds. I won't order BER-SIL, because it would leave Berlin exposed. Keep RUH supporting MUN, HOL off Kiel, MAR held. Use GOL or SPA against Austria. England's BAR-STP is the key to stopping Austria.

Confirmed: A MUN holds, with no move into Kiel or Berlin. France has explicitly renewed RUH support MUN hold; please maintain KIE support. Berlin should hold against SIL. Austria's occupation of STP is decisive unless reversed, but we must deny it Munich regardless.

Confirmed: MUN holds with RUH and promised KIE support. Keep SPA supporting MAR; please use GOL to support SPA hold against WES–SPA supported by TYS. BAR–STP cannot beat a supported Austrian hold, but England must attempt it. Our defenses must remain intact in case Austria vacates STP.

Russia here. Austria's A STP is on your center, and if it holds Austria reaches 18 and we both lose. Your A EDI and F BAR can't both sit idle. Support-hold won't stop it: dislodge it. Use F BAR to STP if you have any support, or order NOR to cut it. F SWE stays off Norway and won't move on you.

notes.note: Fall 1910: F SWE holds. Austria at 17 needs STP; England must dislodge A STP. No useful move for SWE that could stop it. Keep SWE alive.
F1910: BER and DEN hold, KIE supports MUN hold. Austria holds STP and needs only 1 center to win; England's BAR-STP is the key. Everyone promised not to attack me. Watch SIL, BOH, TYR, RUH, HOL.
Fall 1910: BAR-STP to bounce/attack Austrian A STP, SKA-NOR to cover Norway. Others hold. Austria at 17 needs one center; keep bouncing.

MUN holds against BOH/TYR/SIL with confirmed RUH and KIE support. France and Germany kept prior support promises. Austria occupies STP for its eighteenth center; England urged BAR–STP. Preserve Munich in case Austria vacates STP.
Secure solo with STP holding supported by LVN. Probe Munich with two supports; PIE cuts Marseille support while TYS attacks GOL supported WES. Preserve all 17 existing centers.

Last-chance SPA convoy to empty NAP offsets Austrian STP capture if WES leaves Spain alone and convoy survives. MAR holds against PIE; RUH honors Munich support. Changed promised SPA/MAR defense because defense alone concedes Austrian solo.
